project_notes: SILVER/staging models exist 1:1 with each raw source table (`raw_customers`, `raw_orders`, `raw_order_items`), which is structurally compatible with a row-preserving cleanse layer.

Folder-based `+schema` config cleanly separates SILVER (`models/staging` → `DBT_SILVER_SUFFIX`) from default GOLD (`models` root → `DBT_GOLD_SUFFIX`) using environment variables, supporting environment-specific schemas.
All raw tables are declared as dbt sources in `models/schema.yml` under `test_raw`, enabling lineage tracking from raw data into the SILVER models.
There are no core/marts (GOLD) models yet, so the project is currently focused on establishing the SILVER foundation on top of the raw sources.
project_risks: Staging/SILVER models have no accompanying schema.yml definitions for the models themselves (columns, descriptions, data types), so there is no explicit, documented contract for the cleansed layer that downstream users can rely on.

No data tests are defined on either the sources or the staging models (e.g., `not_null`, `unique`, or referential integrity between orders and order_items), leaving key assumptions and relationship integrity unenforced and increasing the risk of silent data quality regressions.

Without visibility into the staging SQL, it is unclear whether the SILVER models are strictly row-preserving; if filters, deduplication, or business rules are applied here instead of in a higher layer, source records could be removed or altered without any explicit quality flags.

Type casting and normalization decisions for Athena-specific data types (timestamps, decimals, booleans, string encodings) are not visible or documented; if the SILVER layer does not standardize types, downstream consumers may encounter inconsistent schemas and subtle casting or comparison bugs.

There is no evident handling or flagging of soft deletes, late-arriving data, or change history at the SILVER layer; if the raw sources include overwrites or deletions, consumers cannot tell whether the SILVER tables represent current state only or some form of preserved history.

No freshness or load timestamp configuration is defined for the `test_raw` sources, reducing observability into pipeline timeliness and increasing the risk that analyses are performed on stale or incomplete data.

actionable_hints: Review and update the cleanse/staging implementation_spec to match the actual raw schemas: explicitly map existing columns (`placed_at` vs `order_date`, `order_status` vs `status`, `product_sku` vs `product_id`/`sku`), remove or redesign expressions that depend on non-existent fields (`id`, `_ingest_ts`, `line_number`, `line_amount`, `currency`, etc.), and re-decide the nullability and semantics of fields like `ingestion_ts` and `updated_at` so that the documented contract can be implemented without ad‑hoc deviations in SQL.

Align `stg_test_raw_raw_customers` with its implementation_spec and with the patterns used in `stg_test_raw_raw_orders` and `stg_test_raw_raw_order_items` by explicitly adding `updated_at` and `ingestion_ts` columns to the final SELECT (even if derived or NULLable placeholders), so downstream consumers can treat these fields as part of a consistent silver-layer schema for all three entities.
notes: REQUIRES PLAN CHANGE: The implementation_spec for all three silver staging models references several raw columns that do not exist in the authoritative schemas (e.g. `id`, `order_number`, `order_timestamp`, `order_date`, `status`, `currency`, `updated_at`, `_ingest_ts`, `line_id`, `line_number`, `line_amount`, `product_id`/`sku` vs `product_sku`). As a result, the SQL implementations were forced to (a) drop some spec fields (`line_number` in `stg_test_raw_raw_order_items`), (b) approximate others from different columns (e.g. using `placed_at` for `order_date`, `created_at`, and `ingestion_ts` in `stg_test_raw_raw_orders`), and (c) leave non-nullable fields effectively nullable (e.g. `ingestion_ts` in `stg_test_raw_raw_order_items` is always NULL). This misalignment directly affects key generation and change-detection (`customer_id`, `order_id`, `row_hash`) and time-based decisions (e.g. using business timestamps vs ingestion timestamps) and will create confusion or silent divergence between the documented contract and what downstream models can actually rely on.

In `models/staging/stg_test_raw_raw_customers.sql`, the silver contract fields `updated_at` and `ingestion_ts` defined in the implementation_spec are missing entirely from the final SELECT, while they are present (even if approximated) in the other two silver models. This creates an inconsistent silver schema for customer vs order/order_item entities and breaks the expectation that downstream models (e.g. SCD/change-data logic or data quality checks) can always rely on `updated_at` and `ingestion_ts` being present across silver tables.

{
  "decision": "patch_plan",
  "tier": "silver",
  "dataset_ids": [
    "example1_silver.stg_test_raw_raw_customers",
    "example1_silver.stg_test_raw_raw_orders",
    "example1_silver.stg_test_raw_raw_order_items"
  ],
  "final_review_text": "Plan-level issues (must be fixed before implementation proceeds)

1) Core misalignment between cleanse/staging spec and actual raw schemas
- Defect: The implementation_spec for all three silver staging models requires columns and semantics that do not exist in the authoritative raw schemas (e.g. `id`, `order_number`, `order_timestamp` / `order_date`, `status`, `currency`, `updated_at`, `_ingest_ts`, `line_id`, `line_number`, `line_amount`, `product_id`/`sku` vs `product_sku`). This has already forced the SQL to silently diverge from the spec (dropping fields like `line_number`, approximating multiple spec fields from `placed_at`, and leaving spec-required fields like `ingestion_ts` effectively always NULL).
- Required plan change: Update the cleanse/staging implementation_spec so that, for each of the three entities, every documented silver column is:
  - Directly mappable from a real raw column (with the correct name and type), or
  - Explicitly defined as a derived field from clearly named raw inputs, or
  - Explicitly dropped from the contract if it cannot be reliably populated.
  This revision should be done by reconciling the spec against the authoritative raw table schemas for `raw_customers`, `raw_orders`, and `raw_order_items`, and then updating column names, presence/absence, and nullability requirements accordingly.

2) Inconsistent lifecycle and time semantics across entities in the spec
- Defect: The spec intends common lifecycle fields (`updated_at`, `ingestion_ts`, and `row_hash`) across customers, orders, and order_items, but (a) the raw sources do not consistently provide timestamps to support these fields, and (b) the spec does not clearly define whether these represent business event time, system update time, or ingestion time. This has already resulted in divergent behavior (e.g. `placed_at` being reused as business, update, and ingestion time in orders; `updated_at` and `ingestion_ts` missing entirely from customers in the current SQL).
- Required plan change: Clarify and normalize the lifecycle contract in the implementation_spec before changing any SQL by:
  - Defining, for each entity, which specific raw timestamp(s) back `updated_at`, which back `ingestion_ts`, and what each field is meant to represent (business event time vs load/ingestion time vs last-change time).
  - Adjusting the spec so that these fields are either: (i) consistently present with well-defined semantics and allowed nullability across all three entities, or (ii) explicitly optional or omitted for entities where the raw source cannot support them.
  Once this is specified, the staging SQL can be brought into conformance without ad-hoc approximations.

3) Silver contract for customers is incomplete relative to orders/order_items
- Defect: The implementation_spec for customers appears to mirror the orders/order_items pattern (including lifecycle and technical fields such as `updated_at`, `ingestion_ts`, and `row_hash`), but the current SQL implementation omits `updated_at` and `ingestion_ts` entirely because the raw `raw_customers` table does not expose obvious source columns. This indicates the spec for customers either overstates what is available, or the intended derivations are not documented.
- Required plan change: Update the customer-specific portion of the implementation_spec to either (a) explicitly define how `updated_at` and `ingestion_ts` are derived from real `raw_customers` columns, or (b) change the customer silver contract so that these columns are optional, differently named, or not part of the standard customer schema. The goal is a documented silver contract for customers that can be implemented without undocumented assumptions.

Insightfulness summary
- Supported use-cases at silver (given the current raw structures and intended 1:1 staging design):
  - Row-preserving entity tables at the grain of customer, order, and order_item, suitable for basic reporting such as customer lists, order volumes, and line-level analyses once the spec is aligned to raw.
  - Foundation for later gold models that aggregate revenue, order frequency, and customer behavior, assuming keys and timestamps are correctly specified in the plan.
- Top 2 semantics gaps in the plan that block higher-value analysis even at silver:
  1) Time axis ambiguity: The spec does not clearly distinguish between business event time (e.g. when an order was placed), system update time, and ingestion/load time, or how these map from actual raw columns per entity.
  2) Entity contract clarity: The meaning and requiredness of lifecycle/technical fields (`updated_at`, `ingestion_ts`, `row_hash`, `line_number`, `currency`, etc.) are not reconciled with what the raw sources can realistically provide, so downstream models cannot rely on a stable, documented silver schema.

Assumptions & evidence gaps (to resolve in the plan)
- Key assumptions currently implicit in the spec:
  - `customer_id` and `order_id` are stable, unique business keys in the raw sources and can safely serve as primary keys in silver.
  - The available raw timestamps (`placed_at` and any others) can faithfully support the intended meanings of `order_date`, `order_timestamp`, `updated_at`, and `ingestion_ts` as described in the spec.
  - Missing fields in the raw tables (e.g. `currency`, `line_number`, certain lifecycle timestamps) are either not actually needed in the silver contract or can be derived without loss of meaning.
- Smallest probes to validate and tighten the plan:
  - Inspect the actual raw schemas and sample data for `raw_customers`, `raw_orders`, and `raw_order_items` to list all available timestamp, ID, and amount fields, then adjust the spec to match what truly exists.
  - Profile uniqueness and nullability of `customer_id` and `order_id` in raw to confirm they can be treated as primary keys in the silver contract.
  - For each lifecycle/technical field in the spec, explicitly map it to a raw column (or mark it as derived/optional) so the plan no longer relies on undocumented or impossible derivations."
}

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id       AS customer_id_raw,
        email,
        first_name        AS first_name_raw,
        last_name         AS last_name_raw,
        created_at        AS created_at_raw
    FROM {{ source("test_raw", "raw_customers") }}
),
clean AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id_raw,
        email,
        first_name_raw,
        last_name_raw,
        created_at_raw,
        -- cleaned customer_id (prefers raw customer_id; falls back to hash of email + names)
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(CAST(customer_id_raw AS varchar), ''),
            TO_HEX(
                MD5(
                    to_utf8(
                        CONCAT(
                            COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(email)), ''),
                            '|',
                            COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(first_name_raw)), ''),
                            '|',
                            COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(last_name_raw)), '')
                        )
                    )
                )
            )
        ) AS customer_id_clean,
        -- normalized email + validity flag
        CASE
            WHEN email IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(TRIM(email)), '^[^@\\s]+@[^@\\s]+\\.[^@\\s]+$')
                THEN LOWER(TRIM(email))
            ELSE NULL
        END AS normalized_email,
        CASE
            WHEN email IS NULL THEN FALSE
            WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(TRIM(email)), '^[^@\\s]+@[^@\\s]+\\.[^@\\s]+$')
                THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS is_email_valid,
        -- cleaned names
        NULLIF(TRIM(first_name_raw), '') AS first_name_clean,
        NULLIF(TRIM(last_name_raw), '')  AS last_name_clean,
        -- created_at as timestamp (source is string)
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(created_at_raw), '') AS timestamp) AS created_at_ts
    FROM base
)
SELECT
    -- raw passthrough columns (renamed with _raw where we also expose a cleaned version)
    customer_id_raw,
    email,
    first_name_raw,
    last_name_raw,
    created_at_raw,

    -- required raw helper
    email AS email_raw,

    -- cleaned / normalized columns per spec
    customer_id_clean AS customer_id,
    normalized_email,
    is_email_valid,
    first_name_clean  AS first_name,
    last_name_clean   AS last_name,
    created_at_ts     AS created_at,

    -- source table identifier
    'AwsDataCatalog.test_raw.raw_customers' AS source_table,

    -- row-level hash for change detection (limited to available fields)
    TO_HEX(
        MD5(
            to_utf8(
                CONCAT_WS(
                    '|',
                    COALESCE(customer_id_clean, ''),
                    COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(email)), ''),
                    COALESCE(CAST(created_at_ts AS varchar), '')
                )
            )
        )
    ) AS row_hash
FROM clean

{{ config(alias="stg_test_raw_raw_orders") }}

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        order_id,
        customer_id,
        order_status,
        total_amount,
        placed_at,
        NULLIF(TRIM(order_id), '')        AS order_id_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(customer_id), '')      AS customer_id_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(order_status), '')     AS order_status_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(total_amount), '')     AS total_amount_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(placed_at), '')        AS placed_at_raw
    FROM {{ source("test_raw", "raw_orders") }}
)
SELECT
    -- Preserve raw columns (renamed to avoid duplicates with cleaned fields)
    base.order_id      AS order_id_raw,
    base.customer_id   AS customer_id_raw,
    base.order_status  AS order_status_raw,
    base.total_amount  AS total_amount_raw,
    base.placed_at     AS placed_at_raw_value,

    -- Cleaned primary order identifier (falls back to hash of customer_id + placed_at when raw order_id is missing/blank)
    COALESCE(
        order_id_str,
        to_hex(md5(to_utf8(COALESCE(customer_id_str, '') || '|' || COALESCE(placed_at_raw, ''))))
    ) AS order_id,

    -- Normalized customer_id
    customer_id_str AS customer_id,

    -- Business order timestamp derived from placed_at
    try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS order_date,

    -- Created-at approximated from placed_at (no dedicated created_at column available)
    try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS created_at,

    -- No updated_at field in source; exposed as NULLable timestamp
    CAST(NULL AS timestamp) AS updated_at,

    -- Normalized order status
    LOWER(order_status_str) AS order_status,

    -- Canonical numeric amount
    try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS total_amount,

    -- No currency field in source; exposed as NULLable string
    CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS currency,

    -- Ingestion timestamp approximated from business order timestamp (no dedicated ingest column)
    try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS ingestion_ts,

    -- Source table identifier
    'AwsDataCatalog.test_raw.raw_orders' AS source_table,

    -- Deterministic row hash for change detection
    to_hex(
        md5(
            to_utf8(
                CONCAT_WS(
                    '|',
                    COALESCE(
                        COALESCE(
                            order_id_str,
                            to_hex(md5(to_utf8(COALESCE(customer_id_str, '') || '|' || COALESCE(placed_at_raw, ''))))
                        ),
                        ''
                    ),
                    COALESCE(customer_id_str, ''),
                    COALESCE(CAST(try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS varchar), ''),
                    COALESCE(CAST(try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS varchar), '')
                )
            )
        )
    ) AS row_hash,

    -- Quality flag for total_amount
    CASE
        WHEN try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) IS NOT NULL
             AND try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) >= 0
        THEN TRUE
        ELSE FALSE
    END AS is_total_amount_non_negative
FROM base

WITH src AS (
    SELECT
        order_item_id AS order_item_id_raw,
        order_id      AS order_id_raw,
        product_sku,
        quantity      AS quantity_raw,
        unit_price    AS unit_price_raw
    FROM {{ source("test_raw", "raw_order_items") }}
),
typed AS (
    SELECT
        -- raw passthrough
        order_item_id_raw,
        order_id_raw,
        product_sku,
        quantity_raw,
        unit_price_raw,

        -- cleaned / normalized fields
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(TRIM(order_item_id_raw), ''),
            to_hex(
                md5(
                    to_utf8(
                        COALESCE(CAST(order_id_raw AS VARCHAR), '') || '|' ||
                        '' -- line_number not available in schema
                    )
                )
            )
        ) AS order_item_id,

        NULLIF(TRIM(order_id_raw), '') AS order_id,

        NULLIF(TRIM(product_sku), '') AS product_id,

        try_cast(NULLIF(TRIM(quantity_raw), '') AS INTEGER) AS quantity,

        try_cast(NULLIF(TRIM(unit_price_raw), '') AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS unit_price,

        -- _ingest_ts not present in schema; keep nullable placeholder
        CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS ingestion_ts
    FROM src
),
with_amounts AS (
    SELECT
        order_item_id_raw,
        order_id_raw,
        product_sku,
        quantity_raw,
        unit_price_raw,
        order_item_id,
        order_id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        unit_price,
        ingestion_ts,
        CASE
            WHEN quantity IS NOT NULL AND unit_price IS NOT NULL THEN
                CAST(quantity AS DECIMAL(18,4)) * unit_price
            ELSE NULL
        END AS line_amount
    FROM typed
),
final AS (
    SELECT
        -- all raw columns preserved
        order_item_id_raw,
        order_id_raw,
        product_sku,
        quantity_raw,
        unit_price_raw,

        -- silver/cleaned columns
        order_item_id,
        order_id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        unit_price,
        line_amount,
        ingestion_ts,

        'AwsDataCatalog.test_raw.raw_order_items' AS source_table,

        to_hex(
            md5(
                to_utf8(
                    CONCAT_WS(
                        '|',
                        COALESCE(CAST(order_item_id AS VARCHAR), ''),
                        COALESCE(CAST(order_id AS VARCHAR), ''),
                        COALESCE(CAST(product_id AS VARCHAR), ''),
                        COALESCE(CAST(quantity AS VARCHAR), ''),
                        COALESCE(CAST(unit_price AS VARCHAR), '')
                    )
                )
            )
        ) AS row_hash,

        CASE
            WHEN quantity IS NOT NULL AND quantity >= 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE
        END AS is_quantity_non_negative,

        CASE
            WHEN (unit_price IS NULL OR unit_price >= 0)
                 AND (line_amount IS NULL OR line_amount >= 0)
            THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS is_amount_non_negative
    FROM with_amounts
)
SELECT
    order_item_id_raw,
    order_id_raw,
    product_sku,
    quantity_raw,
    unit_price_raw,
    order_item_id,
    order_id,
    product_id,
    quantity,
    unit_price,
    line_amount,
    ingestion_ts,
    source_table,
    row_hash,
    is_quantity_non_negative,
    is_amount_non_negative
FROM final;

models:
- name: stg_test_raw_raw_customers
  description: Staging model for raw customers from AwsDataCatalog.test_raw.raw_customers. Cleans and standardizes customer attributes and email fields.
  config:
    materialized: view
    contract:
      enforced: false

{{ config(alias="stg_test_raw_raw_customers") }}

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id       AS customer_id_raw,
        email,
        first_name        AS first_name_raw,
        last_name         AS last_name_raw,
        created_at        AS created_at_raw
    FROM {{ source("test_raw", "raw_customers") }}
),
clean AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id_raw,
        email,
        first_name_raw,
        last_name_raw,
        created_at_raw,
        -- cleaned customer_id (prefers raw customer_id; falls back to hash of email + names)
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(CAST(customer_id_raw AS varchar), ''),
            TO_HEX(
                MD5(
                    to_utf8(
                        CONCAT(
                            COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(email)), ''),
                            '|',
                            COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(first_name_raw)), ''),
                            '|',
                            COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(last_name_raw)), '')
                        )
                    )
                )
            )
        ) AS customer_id_clean,
        -- normalized email + validity flag
        CASE
            WHEN email IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(TRIM(email)), '^[^@\\s]+@[^@\\s]+\\.[^@\\s]+$')
                THEN LOWER(TRIM(email))
            ELSE NULL
        END AS normalized_email,
        CASE
            WHEN email IS NULL THEN FALSE
            WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(TRIM(email)), '^[^@\\s]+@[^@\\s]+\\.[^@\\s]+$')
                THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS is_email_valid,
        -- cleaned names
        NULLIF(TRIM(first_name_raw), '') AS first_name_clean,
        NULLIF(TRIM(last_name_raw), '')  AS last_name_clean,
        -- created_at as timestamp (source is string)
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(created_at_raw), '') AS timestamp) AS created_at_ts
    FROM base
)
SELECT
    -- raw passthrough columns (renamed with _raw where we also expose a cleaned version)
    customer_id_raw,
    email,
    first_name_raw,
    last_name_raw,
    created_at_raw,

    -- required raw helper
    email AS email_raw,

    -- cleaned / normalized columns per spec
    customer_id_clean AS customer_id,
    normalized_email,
    is_email_valid,
    first_name_clean  AS first_name,
    last_name_clean   AS last_name,
    created_at_ts     AS created_at,

    -- source table identifier
    'AwsDataCatalog.test_raw.raw_customers' AS source_table,

    -- row-level hash for change detection (limited to available fields)
    TO_HEX(
        MD5(
            to_utf8(
                CONCAT_WS(
                    '|',
                    COALESCE(customer_id_clean, ''),
                    COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(email)), ''),
                    COALESCE(CAST(created_at_ts AS varchar), '')
                )
            )
        )
    ) AS row_hash
FROM clean

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        order_id,
        customer_id,
        order_status,
        total_amount,
        placed_at,
        NULLIF(TRIM(order_id), '')        AS order_id_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(customer_id), '')      AS customer_id_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(order_status), '')     AS order_status_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(total_amount), '')     AS total_amount_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(placed_at), '')        AS placed_at_raw
    FROM {{ source("test_raw", "raw_orders") }}
)
SELECT
    -- Preserve raw columns (renamed to avoid duplicates with cleaned fields)
    base.order_id      AS order_id_raw,
    base.customer_id   AS customer_id_raw,
    base.order_status  AS order_status_raw,
    base.total_amount  AS total_amount_raw,
    base.placed_at     AS placed_at_raw_value,

    -- Cleaned primary order identifier (falls back to hash of customer_id + placed_at when raw order_id is missing/blank)
    COALESCE(
        order_id_str,
        to_hex(md5(to_utf8(COALESCE(customer_id_str, '') || '|' || COALESCE(placed_at_raw, ''))))
    ) AS order_id,

    -- Normalized customer_id
    customer_id_str AS customer_id,

    -- Business order timestamp derived from placed_at
    try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS order_date,

    -- Created-at approximated from placed_at (no dedicated created_at column available)
    try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS created_at,

    -- No updated_at field in source; exposed as NULLable timestamp
    CAST(NULL AS timestamp) AS updated_at,

    -- Normalized order status
    LOWER(order_status_str) AS order_status,

    -- Canonical numeric amount
    try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS total_amount,

    -- No currency field in source; exposed as NULLable string
    CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS currency,

    -- Ingestion timestamp approximated from business order timestamp (no dedicated ingest column)
    try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS ingestion_ts,

    -- Source table identifier
    'AwsDataCatalog.test_raw.raw_orders' AS source_table,

    -- Deterministic row hash for change detection
    to_hex(
        md5(
            to_utf8(
                CONCAT_WS(
                    '|',
                    COALESCE(
                        COALESCE(
                            order_id_str,
                            to_hex(md5(to_utf8(COALESCE(customer_id_str, '') || '|' || COALESCE(placed_at_raw, ''))))
                        ),
                        ''
                    ),
                    COALESCE(customer_id_str, ''),
                    COALESCE(CAST(try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS varchar), ''),
                    COALESCE(CAST(try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS varchar), '')
                )
            )
        )
    ) AS row_hash,

    -- Quality flag for total_amount
    CASE
        WHEN try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) IS NOT NULL
             AND try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) >= 0
        THEN TRUE
        ELSE FALSE
    END AS is_total_amount_non_negative
FROM base

- Defect: The spec intends common lifecycle fields (`updated_at`, `ingestion_ts`, and `row_hash`) across customers, orders, and order_items, but (a) the raw sources do not consistently provide timestamps to support these fields, and (b) the spec does not clearly define whether these represent business event time, system update time, or ingestion time. This has already resulted in divergent behavior (e.g. `placed_at` being reused as business, update, and ingestion time in orders; `updated_at` and `ingestion_ts` missing entirely from customers in the current SQL).
- Required plan change: Clarify and normalize the lifecycle contract in the implementation_spec before changing any SQL by:
  - Defining, for each entity, which specific raw timestamp(s) back `updated_at`, which back `ingestion_ts`, and what each field is meant to represent (business event time vs load/ingestion time vs last-change time).

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        order_id,
        customer_id,
        order_status,
        total_amount,
        placed_at,
        NULLIF(TRIM(order_id), '')        AS order_id_str,

SELECT
    -- Preserve raw columns (renamed to avoid duplicates with cleaned fields)
    base.order_id      AS order_id_raw,
    base.customer_id   AS customer_id_raw,
    base.order_status  AS order_status_raw,
    base.total_amount  AS total_amount_raw,
    base.placed_at     AS placed_at_raw_value,

    -- Cleaned primary order identifier (falls back to hash of customer_id + placed_at when raw order_id is missing/blank)
    COALESCE(
        order_id_str,
        to_hex(md5(to_utf8(COALESCE(customer_id_str, '') || '|' || COALESCE(placed_at_raw, ''))))
    ) AS order_id,

    -- Normalized customer_id
    customer_id_str AS customer_id,

    -- Business order timestamp derived from placed_at
    try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS order_date,

    -- Created-at approximated from placed_at (no dedicated created_at column available)
    try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS created_at,

    -- No updated_at field in source; exposed as NULLable timestamp
    CAST(NULL AS timestamp) AS updated_at,

    -- Normalized order status
    LOWER(order_status_str) AS order_status,

    -- Canonical numeric amount
    try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS total_amount,

    -- No currency field in source; exposed as NULLable string
    CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS currency,

    -- Ingestion timestamp approximated from business order timestamp (no dedicated ingest column)
    try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS ingestion_ts,

    -- Source table identifier
    'AwsDataCatalog.test_raw.raw_orders' AS source_table,

    -- Deterministic row hash for change detection
    to_hex(
        md5(
            to_utf8(
                CONCAT_WS(
                    '|',
                    COALESCE(
                        COALESCE(
                            order_id_str,
                            to_hex(md5(to_utf8(COALESCE(customer_id_str, '') || '|' || COALESCE(placed_at_raw, ''))))
                        ),
                        ''
                    ),
                    COALESCE(customer_id_str, ''),
                    COALESCE(CAST(try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS varchar), ''),
                    COALESCE(CAST(try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS varchar), '')
                )
            )
        )
    ) AS row_hash,

    -- Quality flag for total_amount
    CASE
        WHEN try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) IS NOT NULL
             AND try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) >= 0
        THEN TRUE
        ELSE FALSE
    END AS is_total_amount_non_negative
FROM base

typed AS (

        product_sku,
        quantity_raw,

                    to_utf8(
                        COALESCE(CAST(order_id_raw AS VARCHAR), '') || '|' ||

                    )
                )
            )
        ) AS order_item_id,

        NULLIF(TRIM(order_id_raw), '') AS order_id,

        try_cast(NULLIF(TRIM(quantity_raw), '') AS INTEGER) AS quantity,

        try_cast(NULLIF(TRIM(unit_price_raw), '') AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS unit_price,

        -- _ingest_ts not present in schema; keep nullable placeholder
        CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS ingestion_ts
    FROM src
),
with_amounts AS (

        order_item_id_raw,
        order_id_raw,
        product_sku,
        quantity_raw,
        unit_price_raw,

        order_id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        unit_price,
        ingestion_ts,

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id       AS customer_id_raw,
        email,
        first_name        AS first_name_raw,
        last_name         AS last_name_raw,
        created_at        AS created_at_raw
    FROM {{ source("test_raw", "raw_customers") }}
),
clean AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id_raw,
        email,
        first_name_raw,
        last_name_raw,
        created_at_raw,
        -- cleaned customer_id (prefers raw customer_id; falls back to hash of email + names)
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(CAST(customer_id_raw AS varchar), ''),
            TO_HEX(
                MD5(
                    to_utf8(
                        CONCAT(
                            COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(email)), ''),
                            '|',
                            COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(first_name_raw)), ''),
                            '|',
                            COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(last_name_raw)), '')
                        )
                    )
                )
            )
        ) AS customer_id_clean,
        -- normalized email + validity flag
        CASE
            WHEN email IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(TRIM(email)), '^[^@\\s]+@[^@\\s]+\\.[^@\\s]+$')
                THEN LOWER(TRIM(email))
            ELSE NULL
        END AS normalized_email,
        CASE
            WHEN email IS NULL THEN FALSE
            WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(TRIM(email)), '^[^@\\s]+@[^@\\s]+\\.[^@\\s]+$')
                THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS is_email_valid,
        -- cleaned names
        NULLIF(TRIM(first_name_raw), '') AS first_name_clean,
        NULLIF(TRIM(last_name_raw), '')  AS last_name_clean,
        -- created_at as timestamp (source is string)
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(created_at_raw), '') AS timestamp) AS created_at_ts
    FROM base
)
SELECT
    -- raw passthrough columns (renamed with _raw where we also expose a cleaned version)
    customer_id_raw,
    email,
    first_name_raw,
    last_name_raw,
    created_at_raw,

    -- required raw helper
    email AS email_raw,

    -- cleaned / normalized columns per spec
    customer_id_clean AS customer_id,
    normalized_email,
    is_email_valid,
    first_name_clean  AS first_name,
    last_name_clean   AS last_name,
    created_at_ts     AS created_at,

    -- source table identifier
    'AwsDataCatalog.test_raw.raw_customers' AS source_table,

    -- row-level hash for change detection (limited to available fields)
    TO_HEX(
        MD5(
            to_utf8(
                CONCAT_WS(
                    '|',
                    COALESCE(customer_id_clean, ''),
                    COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(email)), ''),
                    COALESCE(CAST(created_at_ts AS varchar), '')
                )
            )
        )
    ) AS row_hash
FROM clean

{{ config(alias="stg_test_raw_raw_orders") }}

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        order_id,
        customer_id,
        order_status,
        total_amount,
        placed_at,
        NULLIF(TRIM(order_id), '')        AS order_id_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(customer_id), '')      AS customer_id_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(order_status), '')     AS order_status_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(total_amount), '')     AS total_amount_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(placed_at), '')        AS placed_at_raw
    FROM {{ source("test_raw", "raw_orders") }}
)
SELECT
    -- Preserve raw columns (renamed to avoid duplicates with cleaned fields)
    base.order_id      AS order_id_raw,
    base.customer_id   AS customer_id_raw,
    base.order_status  AS order_status_raw,
    base.total_amount  AS total_amount_raw,
    base.placed_at     AS placed_at_raw_value,

    -- Cleaned primary order identifier (falls back to hash of customer_id + placed_at when raw order_id is missing/blank)
    COALESCE(
        order_id_str,
        to_hex(md5(to_utf8(COALESCE(customer_id_str, '') || '|' || COALESCE(placed_at_raw, ''))))
    ) AS order_id,

    -- Normalized customer_id
    customer_id_str AS customer_id,

    -- Business order timestamp derived from placed_at
    try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS order_date,

    -- Created-at approximated from placed_at (no dedicated created_at column available)
    try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS created_at,

    -- No updated_at field in source; exposed as NULLable timestamp
    CAST(NULL AS timestamp) AS updated_at,

    -- Normalized order status
    LOWER(order_status_str) AS order_status,

    -- Canonical numeric amount
    try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS total_amount,

    -- No currency field in source; exposed as NULLable string
    CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS currency,

    -- Ingestion timestamp approximated from business order timestamp (no dedicated ingest column)
    try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS ingestion_ts,

    -- Source table identifier
    'AwsDataCatalog.test_raw.raw_orders' AS source_table,

    -- Deterministic row hash for change detection
    to_hex(
        md5(
            to_utf8(
                CONCAT_WS(
                    '|',
                    COALESCE(
                        COALESCE(
                            order_id_str,
                            to_hex(md5(to_utf8(COALESCE(customer_id_str, '') || '|' || COALESCE(placed_at_raw, ''))))
                        ),
                        ''
                    ),
                    COALESCE(customer_id_str, ''),
                    COALESCE(CAST(try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS varchar), ''),
                    COALESCE(CAST(try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS varchar), '')
                )
            )
        )
    ) AS row_hash,

    -- Quality flag for total_amount
    CASE
        WHEN try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) IS NOT NULL
             AND try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) >= 0
        THEN TRUE
        ELSE FALSE
    END AS is_total_amount_non_negative
FROM base

WITH src AS (
    SELECT
        order_item_id AS order_item_id_raw,
        order_id      AS order_id_raw,
        product_sku,
        quantity      AS quantity_raw,
        unit_price    AS unit_price_raw
    FROM {{ source("test_raw", "raw_order_items") }}
),
typed AS (
    SELECT
        -- raw passthrough
        order_item_id_raw,
        order_id_raw,
        product_sku,
        quantity_raw,
        unit_price_raw,

        -- cleaned / normalized fields
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(TRIM(order_item_id_raw), ''),
            to_hex(
                md5(
                    to_utf8(
                        COALESCE(CAST(order_id_raw AS VARCHAR), '') || '|' ||
                        '' -- line_number not available in schema
                    )
                )
            )
        ) AS order_item_id,

        NULLIF(TRIM(order_id_raw), '') AS order_id,

        NULLIF(TRIM(product_sku), '') AS product_id,

        try_cast(NULLIF(TRIM(quantity_raw), '') AS INTEGER) AS quantity,

        try_cast(NULLIF(TRIM(unit_price_raw), '') AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS unit_price,

        -- _ingest_ts not present in schema; keep nullable placeholder
        CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS ingestion_ts
    FROM src
),
with_amounts AS (
    SELECT
        order_item_id_raw,
        order_id_raw,
        product_sku,
        quantity_raw,
        unit_price_raw,
        order_item_id,
        order_id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        unit_price,
        ingestion_ts,
        CASE
            WHEN quantity IS NOT NULL AND unit_price IS NOT NULL THEN
                CAST(quantity AS DECIMAL(18,4)) * unit_price
            ELSE NULL
        END AS line_amount
    FROM typed
),
final AS (
    SELECT
        -- all raw columns preserved
        order_item_id_raw,
        order_id_raw,
        product_sku,
        quantity_raw,
        unit_price_raw,

        -- silver/cleaned columns
        order_item_id,
        order_id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        unit_price,
        line_amount,
        ingestion_ts,

        'AwsDataCatalog.test_raw.raw_order_items' AS source_table,

        to_hex(
            md5(
                to_utf8(
                    CONCAT_WS(
                        '|',
                        COALESCE(CAST(order_item_id AS VARCHAR), ''),
                        COALESCE(CAST(order_id AS VARCHAR), ''),
                        COALESCE(CAST(product_id AS VARCHAR), ''),
                        COALESCE(CAST(quantity AS VARCHAR), ''),
                        COALESCE(CAST(unit_price AS VARCHAR), '')
                    )
                )
            )
        ) AS row_hash,

        CASE
            WHEN quantity IS NOT NULL AND quantity >= 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE
        END AS is_quantity_non_negative,

        CASE
            WHEN (unit_price IS NULL OR unit_price >= 0)
                 AND (line_amount IS NULL OR line_amount >= 0)
            THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS is_amount_non_negative
    FROM with_amounts
)
SELECT
    order_item_id_raw,
    order_id_raw,
    product_sku,
    quantity_raw,
    unit_price_raw,
    order_item_id,
    order_id,
    product_id,
    quantity,
    unit_price,
    line_amount,
    ingestion_ts,
    source_table,
    row_hash,
    is_quantity_non_negative,
    is_amount_non_negative
FROM final;

{{ config(alias="stg_test_raw_raw_orders") }}

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        order_id,
        customer_id,
        order_status,
        total_amount,
        placed_at,
        NULLIF(TRIM(order_id), '')        AS order_id_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(customer_id), '')      AS customer_id_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(order_status), '')     AS order_status_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(total_amount), '')     AS total_amount_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(placed_at), '')        AS placed_at_raw
    FROM {{ source("test_raw", "raw_orders") }}
)
SELECT
    -- Preserve raw columns (renamed to avoid duplicates with cleaned fields)
    base.order_id      AS order_id_raw,
    base.customer_id   AS customer_id_raw,
    base.order_status  AS order_status_raw,
    base.total_amount  AS total_amount_raw,
    base.placed_at     AS placed_at_raw_value,

    -- Cleaned primary order identifier (falls back to hash of customer_id + placed_at when raw order_id is missing/blank)
    COALESCE(
        order_id_str,
        to_hex(md5(to_utf8(COALESCE(customer_id_str, '') || '|' || COALESCE(placed_at_raw, ''))))
    ) AS order_id,

    -- Normalized customer_id
    customer_id_str AS customer_id,

    -- Business order timestamp derived from placed_at
    try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS order_date,

    -- Created-at approximated from placed_at (no dedicated created_at column available)
    try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS created_at,

    -- No updated_at field in source; exposed as NULLable timestamp
    CAST(NULL AS timestamp) AS updated_at,

    -- Normalized order status
    LOWER(order_status_str) AS order_status,

    -- Canonical numeric amount
    try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS total_amount,

    -- No currency field in source; exposed as NULLable string
    CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS currency,

    -- Ingestion timestamp approximated from business order timestamp (no dedicated ingest column)
    try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS ingestion_ts,

    -- Source table identifier
    'AwsDataCatalog.test_raw.raw_orders' AS source_table,

    -- Deterministic row hash for change detection
    to_hex(
        md5(
            to_utf8(
                CONCAT_WS(
                    '|',
                    COALESCE(
                        COALESCE(
                            order_id_str,
                            to_hex(md5(to_utf8(COALESCE(customer_id_str, '') || '|' || COALESCE(placed_at_raw, ''))))
                        ),
                        ''
                    ),
                    COALESCE(customer_id_str, ''),
                    COALESCE(CAST(try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS varchar), ''),
                    COALESCE(CAST(try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS varchar), '')
                )
            )
        )
    ) AS row_hash,

    -- Quality flag for total_amount
    CASE
        WHEN try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) IS NOT NULL
             AND try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) >= 0
        THEN TRUE
        ELSE FALSE
    END AS is_total_amount_non_negative
FROM base

clean AS (

        email,
        first_name_raw,
        last_name_raw,
        created_at_raw,
        -- cleaned customer_id (prefers raw customer_id; falls back to hash of email + names)
        COALESCE(

                MD5(
                    to_utf8(
                        CONCAT(

                            '|',

                            '|',
                            COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(last_name_raw)), '')

            )

        -- normalized email + validity flag
        CASE
            WHEN email IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(TRIM(email)), '^[^@\\s]+@[^@\\s]+\\.[^@\\s]+$')

        END AS is_email_valid,
        -- cleaned names
        NULLIF(TRIM(first_name_raw), '') AS first_name_clean,
        NULLIF(TRIM(last_name_raw), '')  AS last_name_clean,
        -- created_at as timestamp (source is string)
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(created_at_raw), '') AS timestamp) AS created_at_ts
    FROM base

{{ config(alias="stg_test_raw_raw_customers") }}

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id       AS customer_id_raw,
        email,
        first_name        AS first_name_raw,
        last_name         AS last_name_raw,
        created_at        AS created_at_raw
    FROM {{ source("test_raw", "raw_customers") }}
),
clean AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id_raw,
        email,
        first_name_raw,
        last_name_raw,
        created_at_raw,
        -- cleaned customer_id (prefers raw customer_id; falls back to hash of email + names)
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(CAST(customer_id_raw AS varchar), ''),
            TO_HEX(
                MD5(
                    to_utf8(
                        CONCAT(
                            COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(email)), ''),
                            '|',
                            COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(first_name_raw)), ''),
                            '|',
                            COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(last_name_raw)), '')
                        )
                    )
                )
            )
        ) AS customer_id_clean,
        -- normalized email + validity flag
        CASE
            WHEN email IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(TRIM(email)), '^[^@\\s]+@[^@\\s]+\\.[^@\\s]+$')
                THEN LOWER(TRIM(email))
            ELSE NULL
        END AS normalized_email,
        CASE
            WHEN email IS NULL THEN FALSE
            WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(TRIM(email)), '^[^@\\s]+@[^@\\s]+\\.[^@\\s]+$')
                THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS is_email_valid,
        -- cleaned names
        NULLIF(TRIM(first_name_raw), '') AS first_name_clean,
        NULLIF(TRIM(last_name_raw), '')  AS last_name_clean,
        -- created_at as timestamp (source is string)
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(created_at_raw), '') AS timestamp) AS created_at_ts
    FROM base
)
SELECT
    -- raw passthrough columns (renamed with _raw where we also expose a cleaned version)
    customer_id_raw,
    email,
    first_name_raw,
    last_name_raw,
    created_at_raw,

    -- required raw helper
    email AS email_raw,

    -- cleaned / normalized columns per spec
    customer_id_clean AS customer_id,
    normalized_email,
    is_email_valid,
    first_name_clean  AS first_name,
    last_name_clean   AS last_name,
    created_at_ts     AS created_at,

    -- source table identifier
    'AwsDataCatalog.test_raw.raw_customers' AS source_table,

    -- row-level hash for change detection (limited to available fields)
    TO_HEX(
        MD5(
            to_utf8(
                CONCAT_WS(
                    '|',
                    COALESCE(customer_id_clean, ''),
                    COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(email)), ''),
                    COALESCE(CAST(created_at_ts AS varchar), '')
                )
            )
        )
    ) AS row_hash
FROM clean

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        order_id,
        customer_id,
        order_status,
        total_amount,
        placed_at,
        NULLIF(TRIM(order_id), '')        AS order_id_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(customer_id), '')      AS customer_id_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(order_status), '')     AS order_status_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(total_amount), '')     AS total_amount_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(placed_at), '')        AS placed_at_raw
    FROM {{ source("test_raw", "raw_orders") }}
)
SELECT
    -- Preserve raw columns (renamed to avoid duplicates with cleaned fields)
    base.order_id      AS order_id_raw,
    base.customer_id   AS customer_id_raw,
    base.order_status  AS order_status_raw,
    base.total_amount  AS total_amount_raw,
    base.placed_at     AS placed_at_raw_value,

    -- Cleaned primary order identifier (falls back to hash of customer_id + placed_at when raw order_id is missing/blank)
    COALESCE(
        order_id_str,
        to_hex(md5(to_utf8(COALESCE(customer_id_str, '') || '|' || COALESCE(placed_at_raw, ''))))
    ) AS order_id,

    -- Normalized customer_id
    customer_id_str AS customer_id,

    -- Business order timestamp derived from placed_at
    try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS order_date,

    -- Created-at approximated from placed_at (no dedicated created_at column available)
    try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS created_at,

    -- No updated_at field in source; exposed as NULLable timestamp
    CAST(NULL AS timestamp) AS updated_at,

    -- Normalized order status
    LOWER(order_status_str) AS order_status,

    -- Canonical numeric amount
    try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS total_amount,

    -- No currency field in source; exposed as NULLable string
    CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS currency,

    -- Ingestion timestamp approximated from business order timestamp (no dedicated ingest column)
    try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS ingestion_ts,

    -- Source table identifier
    'AwsDataCatalog.test_raw.raw_orders' AS source_table,

    -- Deterministic row hash for change detection
    to_hex(
        md5(
            to_utf8(
                CONCAT_WS(
                    '|',
                    COALESCE(
                        COALESCE(
                            order_id_str,
                            to_hex(md5(to_utf8(COALESCE(customer_id_str, '') || '|' || COALESCE(placed_at_raw, ''))))
                        ),
                        ''
                    ),
                    COALESCE(customer_id_str, ''),
                    COALESCE(CAST(try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS varchar), ''),
                    COALESCE(CAST(try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS varchar), '')
                )
            )
        )
    ) AS row_hash,

    -- Quality flag for total_amount
    CASE
        WHEN try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) IS NOT NULL
             AND try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) >= 0
        THEN TRUE
        ELSE FALSE
    END AS is_total_amount_non_negative
FROM base

WITH src AS (
    SELECT
        order_item_id AS order_item_id_raw,
        order_id      AS order_id_raw,
        product_sku,
        quantity      AS quantity_raw,
        unit_price    AS unit_price_raw
    FROM {{ source("test_raw", "raw_order_items") }}
),
typed AS (
    SELECT
        -- raw passthrough
        order_item_id_raw,
        order_id_raw,
        product_sku,
        quantity_raw,
        unit_price_raw,

        -- cleaned / normalized fields
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(TRIM(order_item_id_raw), ''),
            to_hex(
                md5(
                    to_utf8(
                        COALESCE(CAST(order_id_raw AS VARCHAR), '') || '|' ||
                        '' -- line_number not available in schema
                    )
                )
            )
        ) AS order_item_id,

        NULLIF(TRIM(order_id_raw), '') AS order_id,

        NULLIF(TRIM(product_sku), '') AS product_id,

        try_cast(NULLIF(TRIM(quantity_raw), '') AS INTEGER) AS quantity,

        try_cast(NULLIF(TRIM(unit_price_raw), '') AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS unit_price,

        -- _ingest_ts not present in schema; keep nullable placeholder
        CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS ingestion_ts
    FROM src
),
with_amounts AS (
    SELECT
        order_item_id_raw,
        order_id_raw,
        product_sku,
        quantity_raw,
        unit_price_raw,
        order_item_id,
        order_id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        unit_price,
        ingestion_ts,
        CASE
            WHEN quantity IS NOT NULL AND unit_price IS NOT NULL THEN
                CAST(quantity AS DECIMAL(18,4)) * unit_price
            ELSE NULL
        END AS line_amount
    FROM typed
),
final AS (
    SELECT
        -- all raw columns preserved
        order_item_id_raw,
        order_id_raw,
        product_sku,
        quantity_raw,
        unit_price_raw,

        -- silver/cleaned columns
        order_item_id,
        order_id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        unit_price,
        line_amount,
        ingestion_ts,

        'AwsDataCatalog.test_raw.raw_order_items' AS source_table,

        to_hex(
            md5(
                to_utf8(
                    CONCAT_WS(
                        '|',
                        COALESCE(CAST(order_item_id AS VARCHAR), ''),
                        COALESCE(CAST(order_id AS VARCHAR), ''),
                        COALESCE(CAST(product_id AS VARCHAR), ''),
                        COALESCE(CAST(quantity AS VARCHAR), ''),
                        COALESCE(CAST(unit_price AS VARCHAR), '')
                    )
                )
            )
        ) AS row_hash,

        CASE
            WHEN quantity IS NOT NULL AND quantity >= 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE
        END AS is_quantity_non_negative,

        CASE
            WHEN (unit_price IS NULL OR unit_price >= 0)
                 AND (line_amount IS NULL OR line_amount >= 0)
            THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS is_amount_non_negative
    FROM with_amounts
)
SELECT
    order_item_id_raw,
    order_id_raw,
    product_sku,
    quantity_raw,
    unit_price_raw,
    order_item_id,
    order_id,
    product_id,
    quantity,
    unit_price,
    line_amount,
    ingestion_ts,
    source_table,
    row_hash,
    is_quantity_non_negative,
    is_amount_non_negative
FROM final;

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        order_id,
        customer_id,
        order_status,
        total_amount,
        placed_at,
        NULLIF(TRIM(order_id), '')        AS order_id_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(customer_id), '')      AS customer_id_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(order_status), '')     AS order_status_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(total_amount), '')     AS total_amount_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(placed_at), '')        AS placed_at_raw
    FROM {{ source("test_raw", "raw_orders") }}
)
SELECT
    -- Preserve raw columns (renamed to avoid duplicates with cleaned fields)
    base.order_id      AS order_id_raw,
    base.customer_id   AS customer_id_raw,
    base.order_status  AS order_status_raw,
    base.total_amount  AS total_amount_raw,
    base.placed_at     AS placed_at_raw_value,

    -- Cleaned primary order identifier (falls back to hash of customer_id + placed_at when raw order_id is missing/blank)
    COALESCE(
        order_id_str,
        to_hex(md5(to_utf8(COALESCE(customer_id_str, '') || '|' || COALESCE(placed_at_raw, ''))))
    ) AS order_id,

    -- Normalized customer_id
    customer_id_str AS customer_id,

    -- Business order timestamp derived from placed_at
    try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS order_date,

    -- Created-at approximated from placed_at (no dedicated created_at column available)
    try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS created_at,

    -- No updated_at field in source; exposed as NULLable timestamp
    CAST(NULL AS timestamp) AS updated_at,

    -- Normalized order status
    LOWER(order_status_str) AS order_status,

    -- Canonical numeric amount
    try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS total_amount,

    -- No currency field in source; exposed as NULLable string
    CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS currency,

    -- Ingestion timestamp approximated from business order timestamp (no dedicated ingest column)
    try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS ingestion_ts,

    -- Source table identifier
    'AwsDataCatalog.test_raw.raw_orders' AS source_table,

    -- Deterministic row hash for change detection
    to_hex(
        md5(
            to_utf8(
                CONCAT_WS(
                    '|',
                    COALESCE(
                        COALESCE(
                            order_id_str,
                            to_hex(md5(to_utf8(COALESCE(customer_id_str, '') || '|' || COALESCE(placed_at_raw, ''))))
                        ),
                        ''
                    ),
                    COALESCE(customer_id_str, ''),
                    COALESCE(CAST(try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS varchar), ''),
                    COALESCE(CAST(try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS varchar), '')
                )
            )
        )
    ) AS row_hash,

    -- Quality flag for total_amount
    CASE
        WHEN try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) IS NOT NULL
             AND try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) >= 0
        THEN TRUE
        ELSE FALSE
    END AS is_total_amount_non_negative
FROM base

    FROM {{ source("test_raw", "raw_customers") }}
),
clean AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id_raw,
        email,
        first_name_raw,
        last_name_raw,
        created_at_raw,
        -- cleaned customer_id (prefers raw customer_id; falls back to hash of email + names)
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(CAST(customer_id_raw AS varchar), ''),
            TO_HEX(
                MD5(
                    to_utf8(
                        CONCAT(
                            COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(email)), ''),
                            '|',
                            COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(first_name_raw)), ''),
                            '|',
                            COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(last_name_raw)), '')
                        )
                    )
                )
            )
        ) AS customer_id_clean,
        -- normalized email + validity flag
        CASE
            WHEN email IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(TRIM(email)), '^[^@\\s]+@[^@\\s]+\\.[^@\\s]+$')
                THEN LOWER(TRIM(email))
            ELSE NULL
        END AS normalized_email,
        CASE
            WHEN email IS NULL THEN FALSE
            WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(TRIM(email)), '^[^@\\s]+@[^@\\s]+\\.[^@\\s]+$')
                THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS is_email_valid,
        -- cleaned names
        NULLIF(TRIM(first_name_raw), '') AS first_name_clean,
        NULLIF(TRIM(last_name_raw), '')  AS last_name_clean,
        -- created_at as timestamp (source is string)
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(created_at_raw), '') AS timestamp) AS created_at_ts
    FROM base

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        order_id,
        customer_id,
        order_status,
        total_amount,
        placed_at,
        NULLIF(TRIM(order_id), '')        AS order_id_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(customer_id), '')      AS customer_id_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(order_status), '')     AS order_status_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(total_amount), '')     AS total_amount_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(placed_at), '')        AS placed_at_raw
    FROM {{ source("test_raw", "raw_orders") }}
)
SELECT
    -- Preserve raw columns (renamed to avoid duplicates with cleaned fields)
    base.order_id      AS order_id_raw,
    base.customer_id   AS customer_id_raw,
    base.order_status  AS order_status_raw,
    base.total_amount  AS total_amount_raw,
    base.placed_at     AS placed_at_raw_value,

    -- Cleaned primary order identifier (falls back to hash of customer_id + placed_at when raw order_id is missing/blank)
    COALESCE(
        order_id_str,
        to_hex(md5(to_utf8(COALESCE(customer_id_str, '') || '|' || COALESCE(placed_at_raw, ''))))
    ) AS order_id,

    -- Normalized customer_id
    customer_id_str AS customer_id,

    -- Business order timestamp derived from placed_at
    try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS order_date,

    -- Created-at approximated from placed_at (no dedicated created_at column available)
    try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS created_at,

    -- No updated_at field in source; exposed as NULLable timestamp
    CAST(NULL AS timestamp) AS updated_at,

    -- Normalized order status
    LOWER(order_status_str) AS order_status,

    -- Canonical numeric amount
    try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS total_amount,

    -- No currency field in source; exposed as NULLable string
    CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS currency,

    -- Ingestion timestamp approximated from business order timestamp (no dedicated ingest column)
    try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS ingestion_ts,

    -- Source table identifier
    'AwsDataCatalog.test_raw.raw_orders' AS source_table,

    -- Deterministic row hash for change detection
    to_hex(
        md5(
            to_utf8(
                CONCAT_WS(
                    '|',
                    COALESCE(
                        COALESCE(
                            order_id_str,
                            to_hex(md5(to_utf8(COALESCE(customer_id_str, '') || '|' || COALESCE(placed_at_raw, ''))))
                        ),
                        ''
                    ),
                    COALESCE(customer_id_str, ''),
                    COALESCE(CAST(try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS varchar), ''),
                    COALESCE(CAST(try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS varchar), '')
                )
            )
        )
    ) AS row_hash,

    -- Quality flag for total_amount
    CASE
        WHEN try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) IS NOT NULL
             AND try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) >= 0
        THEN TRUE
        ELSE FALSE
    END AS is_total_amount_non_negative
FROM base

{{ config(alias="stg_test_raw_raw_customers") }}

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id       AS customer_id_raw,
        email,
        first_name        AS first_name_raw,
        last_name         AS last_name_raw,
        created_at        AS created_at_raw
    FROM {{ source("test_raw", "raw_customers") }}
),
clean AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id_raw,
        email,
        first_name_raw,
        last_name_raw,
        created_at_raw,
        -- cleaned customer_id (prefers raw customer_id; falls back to hash of email + names)
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(CAST(customer_id_raw AS varchar), ''),
            TO_HEX(
                MD5(
                    to_utf8(
                        CONCAT(
                            COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(email)), ''),
                            '|',
                            COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(first_name_raw)), ''),
                            '|',
                            COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(last_name_raw)), '')
                        )
                    )
                )
            )
        ) AS customer_id_clean,
        -- normalized email + validity flag
        CASE
            WHEN email IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(TRIM(email)), '^[^@\\s]+@[^@\\s]+\\.[^@\\s]+$')
                THEN LOWER(TRIM(email))
            ELSE NULL
        END AS normalized_email,
        CASE
            WHEN email IS NULL THEN FALSE
            WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(TRIM(email)), '^[^@\\s]+@[^@\\s]+\\.[^@\\s]+$')
                THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS is_email_valid,
        -- cleaned names
        NULLIF(TRIM(first_name_raw), '') AS first_name_clean,
        NULLIF(TRIM(last_name_raw), '')  AS last_name_clean,
        -- created_at as timestamp (source is string)
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(created_at_raw), '') AS timestamp) AS created_at_ts
    FROM base
)
SELECT
    -- raw passthrough columns (renamed with _raw where we also expose a cleaned version)
    customer_id_raw,
    email,
    first_name_raw,
    last_name_raw,
    created_at_raw,

    -- required raw helper
    email AS email_raw,

    -- cleaned / normalized columns per spec
    customer_id_clean AS customer_id,
    normalized_email,
    is_email_valid,
    first_name_clean  AS first_name,
    last_name_clean   AS last_name,
    created_at_ts     AS created_at,

    -- source table identifier
    'AwsDataCatalog.test_raw.raw_customers' AS source_table,

    -- row-level hash for change detection (limited to available fields)
    TO_HEX(
        MD5(
            to_utf8(
                CONCAT_WS(
                    '|',
                    COALESCE(customer_id_clean, ''),
                    COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(email)), ''),
                    COALESCE(CAST(created_at_ts AS varchar), '')
                )
            )
        )
    ) AS row_hash
FROM clean

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id       AS customer_id_raw,
        email,
        first_name        AS first_name_raw,
        last_name         AS last_name_raw,
        created_at        AS created_at_raw
    FROM {{ source("test_raw", "raw_customers") }}
),
clean AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id_raw,
        email,
        first_name_raw,
        last_name_raw,
        created_at_raw,
        -- cleaned customer_id (prefers raw customer_id; falls back to hash of email + names)
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(CAST(customer_id_raw AS varchar), ''),
            TO_HEX(
                MD5(
                    to_utf8(
                        CONCAT(
                            COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(email)), ''),
                            '|',
                            COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(first_name_raw)), ''),
                            '|',
                            COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(last_name_raw)), '')
                        )
                    )
                )
            )
        ) AS customer_id_clean,
        -- normalized email + validity flag
        CASE
            WHEN email IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(TRIM(email)), '^[^@\\s]+@[^@\\s]+\\.[^@\\s]+$')
                THEN LOWER(TRIM(email))
            ELSE NULL
        END AS normalized_email,
        CASE
            WHEN email IS NULL THEN FALSE
            WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(TRIM(email)), '^[^@\\s]+@[^@\\s]+\\.[^@\\s]+$')
                THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS is_email_valid,
        -- cleaned names
        NULLIF(TRIM(first_name_raw), '') AS first_name_clean,
        NULLIF(TRIM(last_name_raw), '')  AS last_name_clean,
        -- created_at as timestamp (source is string)
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(created_at_raw), '') AS timestamp) AS created_at_ts
    FROM base
)
SELECT
    -- raw passthrough columns (renamed with _raw where we also expose a cleaned version)
    customer_id_raw,
    email,
    first_name_raw,
    last_name_raw,
    created_at_raw,

    -- required raw helper
    email AS email_raw,

    -- cleaned / normalized columns per spec
    customer_id_clean AS customer_id,
    normalized_email,
    is_email_valid,
    first_name_clean  AS first_name,
    last_name_clean   AS last_name,
    created_at_ts     AS created_at,

    -- source table identifier
    'AwsDataCatalog.test_raw.raw_customers' AS source_table,

    -- row-level hash for change detection (limited to available fields)
    TO_HEX(
        MD5(
            to_utf8(
                CONCAT_WS(
                    '|',
                    COALESCE(customer_id_clean, ''),
                    COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(email)), ''),
                    COALESCE(CAST(created_at_ts AS varchar), '')
                )
            )
        )
    ) AS row_hash
FROM clean

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        order_id,
        customer_id,
        order_status,
        total_amount,
        placed_at,
        NULLIF(TRIM(order_id), '')        AS order_id_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(customer_id), '')      AS customer_id_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(order_status), '')     AS order_status_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(total_amount), '')     AS total_amount_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(placed_at), '')        AS placed_at_raw
    FROM {{ source("test_raw", "raw_orders") }}
)
SELECT
    -- Preserve raw columns (renamed to avoid duplicates with cleaned fields)
    base.order_id      AS order_id_raw,
    base.customer_id   AS customer_id_raw,
    base.order_status  AS order_status_raw,
    base.total_amount  AS total_amount_raw,
    base.placed_at     AS placed_at_raw_value,

    -- Cleaned primary order identifier (falls back to hash of customer_id + placed_at when raw order_id is missing/blank)
    COALESCE(
        order_id_str,
        to_hex(md5(to_utf8(COALESCE(customer_id_str, '') || '|' || COALESCE(placed_at_raw, ''))))
    ) AS order_id,

    -- Normalized customer_id
    customer_id_str AS customer_id,

    -- Business order timestamp derived from placed_at
    try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS order_date,

    -- Created-at approximated from placed_at (no dedicated created_at column available)
    try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS created_at,

    -- No updated_at field in source; exposed as NULLable timestamp
    CAST(NULL AS timestamp) AS updated_at,

    -- Normalized order status
    LOWER(order_status_str) AS order_status,

    -- Canonical numeric amount
    try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS total_amount,

    -- No currency field in source; exposed as NULLable string
    CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS currency,

    -- Ingestion timestamp approximated from business order timestamp (no dedicated ingest column)
    try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS ingestion_ts,

    -- Source table identifier
    'AwsDataCatalog.test_raw.raw_orders' AS source_table,

    -- Deterministic row hash for change detection
    to_hex(
        md5(
            to_utf8(
                CONCAT_WS(
                    '|',
                    COALESCE(
                        COALESCE(
                            order_id_str,
                            to_hex(md5(to_utf8(COALESCE(customer_id_str, '') || '|' || COALESCE(placed_at_raw, ''))))
                        ),
                        ''
                    ),
                    COALESCE(customer_id_str, ''),
                    COALESCE(CAST(try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS varchar), ''),
                    COALESCE(CAST(try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS varchar), '')
                )
            )
        )
    ) AS row_hash,

    -- Quality flag for total_amount
    CASE
        WHEN try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) IS NOT NULL
             AND try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) >= 0
        THEN TRUE
        ELSE FALSE
    END AS is_total_amount_non_negative
FROM base

                    to_utf8(
                        COALESCE(CAST(order_id_raw AS VARCHAR), '') || '|' ||

        try_cast(NULLIF(TRIM(unit_price_raw), '') AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS unit_price,

        CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS ingestion_ts

),
with_amounts AS (

        order_id_raw,
        product_sku,
        quantity_raw,
        unit_price_raw,
        order_item_id,

        product_id,
        quantity,
        unit_price,
        ingestion_ts,

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id       AS customer_id_raw,
        email,
        first_name        AS first_name_raw,
        last_name         AS last_name_raw,
        created_at        AS created_at_raw
    FROM {{ source("test_raw", "raw_customers") }}
),
clean AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id_raw,
        email,
        first_name_raw,
        last_name_raw,
        created_at_raw,
        -- cleaned customer_id (prefers raw customer_id; falls back to hash of email + names)
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(CAST(customer_id_raw AS varchar), ''),
            TO_HEX(
                MD5(
                    to_utf8(
                        CONCAT(
                            COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(email)), ''),
                            '|',
                            COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(first_name_raw)), ''),
                            '|',
                            COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(last_name_raw)), '')
                        )
                    )
                )
            )
        ) AS customer_id_clean,
        -- normalized email + validity flag
        CASE
            WHEN email IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(TRIM(email)), '^[^@\\s]+@[^@\\s]+\\.[^@\\s]+$')
                THEN LOWER(TRIM(email))
            ELSE NULL
        END AS normalized_email,
        CASE
            WHEN email IS NULL THEN FALSE
            WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(TRIM(email)), '^[^@\\s]+@[^@\\s]+\\.[^@\\s]+$')
                THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS is_email_valid,
        -- cleaned names
        NULLIF(TRIM(first_name_raw), '') AS first_name_clean,
        NULLIF(TRIM(last_name_raw), '')  AS last_name_clean,
        -- created_at as timestamp (source is string)
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(created_at_raw), '') AS timestamp) AS created_at_ts
    FROM base
)
SELECT
    -- raw passthrough columns (renamed with _raw where we also expose a cleaned version)
    customer_id_raw,
    email,
    first_name_raw,
    last_name_raw,
    created_at_raw,

    -- required raw helper
    email AS email_raw,

    -- cleaned / normalized columns per spec
    customer_id_clean AS customer_id,
    normalized_email,
    is_email_valid,
    first_name_clean  AS first_name,
    last_name_clean   AS last_name,
    created_at_ts     AS created_at,

    -- source table identifier
    'AwsDataCatalog.test_raw.raw_customers' AS source_table,

    -- row-level hash for change detection (limited to available fields)
    TO_HEX(
        MD5(
            to_utf8(
                CONCAT_WS(
                    '|',
                    COALESCE(customer_id_clean, ''),
                    COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(email)), ''),
                    COALESCE(CAST(created_at_ts AS varchar), '')
                )
            )
        )
    ) AS row_hash
FROM clean

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        order_id,
        customer_id,
        order_status,
        total_amount,
        placed_at,
        NULLIF(TRIM(order_id), '')        AS order_id_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(customer_id), '')      AS customer_id_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(order_status), '')     AS order_status_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(total_amount), '')     AS total_amount_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(placed_at), '')        AS placed_at_raw
    FROM {{ source("test_raw", "raw_orders") }}
)
SELECT
    -- Preserve raw columns (renamed to avoid duplicates with cleaned fields)
    base.order_id      AS order_id_raw,
    base.customer_id   AS customer_id_raw,
    base.order_status  AS order_status_raw,
    base.total_amount  AS total_amount_raw,
    base.placed_at     AS placed_at_raw_value,

    -- Cleaned primary order identifier (falls back to hash of customer_id + placed_at when raw order_id is missing/blank)
    COALESCE(
        order_id_str,
        to_hex(md5(to_utf8(COALESCE(customer_id_str, '') || '|' || COALESCE(placed_at_raw, ''))))
    ) AS order_id,

    -- Normalized customer_id
    customer_id_str AS customer_id,

    -- Business order timestamp derived from placed_at
    try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS order_date,

    -- Created-at approximated from placed_at (no dedicated created_at column available)
    try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS created_at,

    -- No updated_at field in source; exposed as NULLable timestamp
    CAST(NULL AS timestamp) AS updated_at,

    -- Normalized order status
    LOWER(order_status_str) AS order_status,

    -- Canonical numeric amount
    try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS total_amount,

    -- No currency field in source; exposed as NULLable string
    CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS currency,

    -- Ingestion timestamp approximated from business order timestamp (no dedicated ingest column)
    try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS ingestion_ts,

    -- Source table identifier
    'AwsDataCatalog.test_raw.raw_orders' AS source_table,

    -- Deterministic row hash for change detection
    to_hex(
        md5(
            to_utf8(
                CONCAT_WS(
                    '|',
                    COALESCE(
                        COALESCE(
                            order_id_str,
                            to_hex(md5(to_utf8(COALESCE(customer_id_str, '') || '|' || COALESCE(placed_at_raw, ''))))
                        ),
                        ''
                    ),
                    COALESCE(customer_id_str, ''),
                    COALESCE(CAST(try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS varchar), ''),
                    COALESCE(CAST(try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS varchar), '')
                )
            )
        )
    ) AS row_hash,

    -- Quality flag for total_amount
    CASE
        WHEN try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) IS NOT NULL
             AND try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) >= 0
        THEN TRUE
        ELSE FALSE
    END AS is_total_amount_non_negative
FROM base

2) Inconsistent lifecycle and time semantics across entities in the spec
- Defect: The spec intends common lifecycle fields (`updated_at`, `ingestion_ts`, and `row_hash`) across customers, orders, and order_items, but (a) the raw sources do not consistently provide timestamps to support these fields, and (b) the spec does not clearly define whether these represent business event time, system update time, or ingestion time. This has already resulted in divergent behavior (e.g. `placed_at` being reused as business, update, and ingestion time in orders; `updated_at` and `ingestion_ts` missing entirely from customers in the current SQL).
- Required plan change: Clarify and normalize the lifecycle contract in the implementation_spec before changing any SQL by:
  - Defining, for each entity, which specific raw timestamp(s) back `updated_at`, which back `ingestion_ts`, and what each field is meant to represent (business event time vs load/ingestion time vs last-change time).

models:
- name: stg_test_raw_raw_customers
  description: Staging model for raw customers from AwsDataCatalog.test_raw.raw_customers. Cleans and standardizes customer attributes and email fields.
  config:
    materialized: view
    contract:
      enforced: false
  columns:
  - name: customer_id
    description: Canonical customer identifier after cleansing and type normalization.
    tests:
    - not_null
  - name: customer_id_raw
    description: Customer identifier as ingested from the raw source without transformation.
  - name: email
    description: Cleaned and standardized email address for the customer.
  - name: email_raw
    description: Email address exactly as received from the raw source system.
  - name: normalized_email
    description: Normalization of the email used for deduplication (e.g., case-folded and trimmed).
  - name: is_email_valid
    description: Indicates whether the customer email passed validation checks in the staging layer.
  - name: first_name
    description: Cleaned customer first name with standardized casing.
  - name: first_name_raw
    description: Customer first name as originally provided in the raw source.
  - name: last_name
    description: Cleaned customer last name with standardized casing.
  - name: last_name_raw
    description: Customer last name as originally provided in the raw source.
  - name: created_at
    description: Timestamp when the customer record was created in the source, after type casting.
  - name: created_at_raw
    description: Raw representation of the created_at timestamp as ingested from the source.
  - name: source_table
    description: Originating raw table for this customer record (lineage aid when multiple sources feed the model).
  - name: row_hash
    description: Hash of the business key and relevant attributes used to detect changes and deduplicate records.
    tests:
    - not_null
