WITH src AS (
    SELECT
        order_item_id AS order_item_id_raw,
        order_id      AS order_id_raw,
        product_sku,
        quantity      AS quantity_raw,
        unit_price    AS unit_price_raw
    FROM {{ source("test_raw", "raw_order_items") }}
),
typed AS (
    SELECT
        -- raw passthrough
        order_item_id_raw,
        order_id_raw,
        product_sku,
        quantity_raw,
        unit_price_raw,

        -- cleaned / normalized fields
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(TRIM(order_item_id_raw), ''),
            to_hex(
                md5(
                    to_utf8(
                        COALESCE(CAST(order_id_raw AS VARCHAR), '') || '|' ||
                        '' -- line_number not available in schema
                    )
                )
            )
        ) AS order_item_id,

        NULLIF(TRIM(order_id_raw), '') AS order_id,

        NULLIF(TRIM(product_sku), '') AS product_id,

        try_cast(NULLIF(TRIM(quantity_raw), '') AS INTEGER) AS quantity,

        try_cast(NULLIF(TRIM(unit_price_raw), '') AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS unit_price,

        -- _ingest_ts not present in schema; keep nullable placeholder
        CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS ingestion_ts
    FROM src
),
with_amounts AS (
    SELECT
        order_item_id_raw,
        order_id_raw,
        product_sku,
        quantity_raw,
        unit_price_raw,
        order_item_id,
        order_id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        unit_price,
        ingestion_ts,
        CASE
            WHEN quantity IS NOT NULL AND unit_price IS NOT NULL THEN
                CAST(quantity AS DECIMAL(18,4)) * unit_price
            ELSE NULL
        END AS line_amount
    FROM typed
),
final AS (
    SELECT
        -- all raw columns preserved
        order_item_id_raw,
        order_id_raw,
        product_sku,
        quantity_raw,
        unit_price_raw,

        -- silver/cleaned columns
        order_item_id,
        order_id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        unit_price,
        line_amount,
        ingestion_ts,

        'AwsDataCatalog.test_raw.raw_order_items' AS source_table,

        to_hex(
            md5(
                to_utf8(
                    CONCAT_WS(
                        '|',
                        COALESCE(CAST(order_item_id AS VARCHAR), ''),
                        COALESCE(CAST(order_id AS VARCHAR), ''),
                        COALESCE(CAST(product_id AS VARCHAR), ''),
                        COALESCE(CAST(quantity AS VARCHAR), ''),
                        COALESCE(CAST(unit_price AS VARCHAR), '')
                    )
                )
            )
        ) AS row_hash,

        CASE
            WHEN quantity IS NOT NULL AND quantity >= 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE
        END AS is_quantity_non_negative,

        CASE
            WHEN (unit_price IS NULL OR unit_price >= 0)
                 AND (line_amount IS NULL OR line_amount >= 0)
            THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS is_amount_non_negative
    FROM with_amounts
)
SELECT
    order_item_id_raw,
    order_id_raw,
    product_sku,
    quantity_raw,
    unit_price_raw,
    order_item_id,
    order_id,
    product_id,
    quantity,
    unit_price,
    line_amount,
    ingestion_ts,
    source_table,
    row_hash,
    is_quantity_non_negative,
    is_amount_non_negative
FROM final;

{{ config(alias="stg_test_raw_raw_customers") }}

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id       AS customer_id_raw,
        email,
        first_name        AS first_name_raw,
        last_name         AS last_name_raw,
        created_at        AS created_at_raw
    FROM {{ source("test_raw", "raw_customers") }}
),
clean AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id_raw,
        email,
        first_name_raw,
        last_name_raw,
        created_at_raw,
        -- cleaned customer_id (prefers raw customer_id; falls back to hash of email + names)
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(CAST(customer_id_raw AS varchar), ''),
            TO_HEX(
                MD5(
                    to_utf8(
                        CONCAT(
                            COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(email)), ''),
                            '|',
                            COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(first_name_raw)), ''),
                            '|',
                            COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(last_name_raw)), '')
                        )
                    )
                )
            )
        ) AS customer_id_clean,
        -- normalized email + validity flag
        CASE
            WHEN email IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(TRIM(email)), '^[^@\\s]+@[^@\\s]+\\.[^@\\s]+$')
                THEN LOWER(TRIM(email))
            ELSE NULL
        END AS normalized_email,
        CASE
            WHEN email IS NULL THEN FALSE
            WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(TRIM(email)), '^[^@\\s]+@[^@\\s]+\\.[^@\\s]+$')
                THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS is_email_valid,
        -- cleaned names
        NULLIF(TRIM(first_name_raw), '') AS first_name_clean,
        NULLIF(TRIM(last_name_raw), '')  AS last_name_clean,
        -- created_at as timestamp (source is string)
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(created_at_raw), '') AS timestamp) AS created_at_ts
    FROM base
)
SELECT
    -- raw passthrough columns (renamed with _raw where we also expose a cleaned version)
    customer_id_raw,
    email,
    first_name_raw,
    last_name_raw,
    created_at_raw,

    -- required raw helper
    email AS email_raw,

    -- cleaned / normalized columns per spec
    customer_id_clean AS customer_id,
    normalized_email,
    is_email_valid,
    first_name_clean  AS first_name,
    last_name_clean   AS last_name,
    created_at_ts     AS created_at,

    -- source table identifier
    'AwsDataCatalog.test_raw.raw_customers' AS source_table,

    -- row-level hash for change detection (limited to available fields)
    TO_HEX(
        MD5(
            to_utf8(
                CONCAT_WS(
                    '|',
                    COALESCE(customer_id_clean, ''),
                    COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(email)), ''),
                    COALESCE(CAST(created_at_ts AS varchar), '')
                )
            )
        )
    ) AS row_hash
FROM clean

2) Inconsistent lifecycle and time semantics across entities in the spec
- Defect: The spec intends common lifecycle fields (`updated_at`, `ingestion_ts`, and `row_hash`) across customers, orders, and order_items, but (a) the raw sources do not consistently provide timestamps to support these fields, and (b) the spec does not clearly define whether these represent business event time, system update time, or ingestion time. This has already resulted in divergent behavior (e.g. `placed_at` being reused as business, update, and ingestion time in orders; `updated_at` and `ingestion_ts` missing entirely from customers in the current SQL).
- Required plan change: Clarify and normalize the lifecycle contract in the implementation_spec before changing any SQL by:
  - Defining, for each entity, which specific raw timestamp(s) back `updated_at`, which back `ingestion_ts`, and what each field is meant to represent (business event time vs load/ingestion time vs last-change time).

{{ config(alias="stg_test_raw_raw_orders") }}

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        order_id,
        customer_id,
        order_status,
        total_amount,
        placed_at,
        NULLIF(TRIM(order_id), '')        AS order_id_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(customer_id), '')      AS customer_id_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(order_status), '')     AS order_status_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(total_amount), '')     AS total_amount_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(placed_at), '')        AS placed_at_raw
    FROM {{ source("test_raw", "raw_orders") }}
)
SELECT
    -- Preserve raw columns (renamed to avoid duplicates with cleaned fields)
    base.order_id      AS order_id_raw,
    base.customer_id   AS customer_id_raw,
    base.order_status  AS order_status_raw,
    base.total_amount  AS total_amount_raw,
    base.placed_at     AS placed_at_raw_value,

    -- Cleaned primary order identifier (falls back to hash of customer_id + placed_at when raw order_id is missing/blank)
    COALESCE(
        order_id_str,
        to_hex(md5(to_utf8(COALESCE(customer_id_str, '') || '|' || COALESCE(placed_at_raw, ''))))
    ) AS order_id,

    -- Normalized customer_id
    customer_id_str AS customer_id,

    -- Business order timestamp derived from placed_at
    try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS order_date,

    -- Created-at approximated from placed_at (no dedicated created_at column available)
    try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS created_at,

    -- No updated_at field in source; exposed as NULLable timestamp
    CAST(NULL AS timestamp) AS updated_at,

    -- Normalized order status
    LOWER(order_status_str) AS order_status,

    -- Canonical numeric amount
    try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS total_amount,

    -- No currency field in source; exposed as NULLable string
    CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS currency,

    -- Ingestion timestamp approximated from business order timestamp (no dedicated ingest column)
    try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS ingestion_ts,

    -- Source table identifier
    'AwsDataCatalog.test_raw.raw_orders' AS source_table,

    -- Deterministic row hash for change detection
    to_hex(
        md5(
            to_utf8(
                CONCAT_WS(
                    '|',
                    COALESCE(
                        COALESCE(
                            order_id_str,
                            to_hex(md5(to_utf8(COALESCE(customer_id_str, '') || '|' || COALESCE(placed_at_raw, ''))))
                        ),
                        ''
                    ),
                    COALESCE(customer_id_str, ''),
                    COALESCE(CAST(try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS varchar), ''),
                    COALESCE(CAST(try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS varchar), '')
                )
            )
        )
    ) AS row_hash,

    -- Quality flag for total_amount
    CASE
        WHEN try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) IS NOT NULL
             AND try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) >= 0
        THEN TRUE
        ELSE FALSE
    END AS is_total_amount_non_negative
FROM base

WITH src AS (
    SELECT
        order_item_id AS order_item_id_raw,
        order_id      AS order_id_raw,
        product_sku,
        quantity      AS quantity_raw,
        unit_price    AS unit_price_raw
    FROM {{ source("test_raw", "raw_order_items") }}
),
typed AS (
    SELECT
        -- raw passthrough
        order_item_id_raw,
        order_id_raw,
        product_sku,
        quantity_raw,
        unit_price_raw,

        -- cleaned / normalized fields
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(TRIM(order_item_id_raw), ''),
            to_hex(
                md5(
                    to_utf8(
                        COALESCE(CAST(order_id_raw AS VARCHAR), '') || '|' ||
                        '' -- line_number not available in schema
                    )
                )
            )
        ) AS order_item_id,

        NULLIF(TRIM(order_id_raw), '') AS order_id,

        NULLIF(TRIM(product_sku), '') AS product_id,

        try_cast(NULLIF(TRIM(quantity_raw), '') AS INTEGER) AS quantity,

        try_cast(NULLIF(TRIM(unit_price_raw), '') AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS unit_price,

        -- _ingest_ts not present in schema; keep nullable placeholder
        CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS ingestion_ts
    FROM src
),
with_amounts AS (
    SELECT
        order_item_id_raw,
        order_id_raw,
        product_sku,
        quantity_raw,
        unit_price_raw,
        order_item_id,
        order_id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        unit_price,
        ingestion_ts,
        CASE
            WHEN quantity IS NOT NULL AND unit_price IS NOT NULL THEN
                CAST(quantity AS DECIMAL(18,4)) * unit_price
            ELSE NULL
        END AS line_amount
    FROM typed
),
final AS (
    SELECT
        -- all raw columns preserved
        order_item_id_raw,
        order_id_raw,
        product_sku,
        quantity_raw,
        unit_price_raw,

        -- silver/cleaned columns
        order_item_id,
        order_id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        unit_price,
        line_amount,
        ingestion_ts,

        'AwsDataCatalog.test_raw.raw_order_items' AS source_table,

        to_hex(
            md5(
                to_utf8(
                    CONCAT_WS(
                        '|',
                        COALESCE(CAST(order_item_id AS VARCHAR), ''),
                        COALESCE(CAST(order_id AS VARCHAR), ''),
                        COALESCE(CAST(product_id AS VARCHAR), ''),
                        COALESCE(CAST(quantity AS VARCHAR), ''),
                        COALESCE(CAST(unit_price AS VARCHAR), '')
                    )
                )
            )
        ) AS row_hash,

        CASE
            WHEN quantity IS NOT NULL AND quantity >= 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE
        END AS is_quantity_non_negative,

        CASE
            WHEN (unit_price IS NULL OR unit_price >= 0)
                 AND (line_amount IS NULL OR line_amount >= 0)
            THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS is_amount_non_negative
    FROM with_amounts
)
SELECT
    order_item_id_raw,
    order_id_raw,
    product_sku,
    quantity_raw,
    unit_price_raw,
    order_item_id,
    order_id,
    product_id,
    quantity,
    unit_price,
    line_amount,
    ingestion_ts,
    source_table,
    row_hash,
    is_quantity_non_negative,
    is_amount_non_negative
FROM final;

{{ config(alias="stg_test_raw_raw_orders") }}

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        order_id,
        customer_id,
        order_status,
        total_amount,
        placed_at,
        NULLIF(TRIM(order_id), '')        AS order_id_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(customer_id), '')      AS customer_id_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(order_status), '')     AS order_status_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(total_amount), '')     AS total_amount_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(placed_at), '')        AS placed_at_raw
    FROM {{ source("test_raw", "raw_orders") }}
)
SELECT
    -- Preserve raw columns (renamed to avoid duplicates with cleaned fields)
    base.order_id      AS order_id_raw,
    base.customer_id   AS customer_id_raw,
    base.order_status  AS order_status_raw,
    base.total_amount  AS total_amount_raw,
    base.placed_at     AS placed_at_raw_value,

    -- Cleaned primary order identifier (falls back to hash of customer_id + placed_at when raw order_id is missing/blank)
    COALESCE(
        order_id_str,
        to_hex(md5(to_utf8(COALESCE(customer_id_str, '') || '|' || COALESCE(placed_at_raw, ''))))
    ) AS order_id,

    -- Normalized customer_id
    customer_id_str AS customer_id,

    -- Business order timestamp derived from placed_at
    try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS order_date,

    -- Created-at approximated from placed_at (no dedicated created_at column available)
    try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS created_at,

    -- No updated_at field in source; exposed as NULLable timestamp
    CAST(NULL AS timestamp) AS updated_at,

    -- Normalized order status
    LOWER(order_status_str) AS order_status,

    -- Canonical numeric amount
    try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS total_amount,

    -- No currency field in source; exposed as NULLable string
    CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS currency,

    -- Ingestion timestamp approximated from business order timestamp (no dedicated ingest column)
    try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS ingestion_ts,

    -- Source table identifier
    'AwsDataCatalog.test_raw.raw_orders' AS source_table,

    -- Deterministic row hash for change detection
    to_hex(
        md5(
            to_utf8(
                CONCAT_WS(
                    '|',
                    COALESCE(
                        COALESCE(
                            order_id_str,
                            to_hex(md5(to_utf8(COALESCE(customer_id_str, '') || '|' || COALESCE(placed_at_raw, ''))))
                        ),
                        ''
                    ),
                    COALESCE(customer_id_str, ''),
                    COALESCE(CAST(try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS varchar), ''),
                    COALESCE(CAST(try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS varchar), '')
                )
            )
        )
    ) AS row_hash,

    -- Quality flag for total_amount
    CASE
        WHEN try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) IS NOT NULL
             AND try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) >= 0
        THEN TRUE
        ELSE FALSE
    END AS is_total_amount_non_negative
FROM base

{{ config(alias="stg_test_raw_raw_customers") }}

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id       AS customer_id_raw,
        email,
        first_name        AS first_name_raw,
        last_name         AS last_name_raw,
        created_at        AS created_at_raw
    FROM {{ source("test_raw", "raw_customers") }}
),
clean AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id_raw,
        email,
        first_name_raw,
        last_name_raw,
        created_at_raw,
        -- cleaned customer_id (prefers raw customer_id; falls back to hash of email + names)
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(CAST(customer_id_raw AS varchar), ''),
            TO_HEX(
                MD5(
                    to_utf8(
                        CONCAT(
                            COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(email)), ''),
                            '|',
                            COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(first_name_raw)), ''),
                            '|',
                            COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(last_name_raw)), '')
                        )
                    )
                )
            )
        ) AS customer_id_clean,
        -- normalized email + validity flag
        CASE
            WHEN email IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(TRIM(email)), '^[^@\\s]+@[^@\\s]+\\.[^@\\s]+$')
                THEN LOWER(TRIM(email))
            ELSE NULL
        END AS normalized_email,
        CASE
            WHEN email IS NULL THEN FALSE
            WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(TRIM(email)), '^[^@\\s]+@[^@\\s]+\\.[^@\\s]+$')
                THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS is_email_valid,
        -- cleaned names
        NULLIF(TRIM(first_name_raw), '') AS first_name_clean,
        NULLIF(TRIM(last_name_raw), '')  AS last_name_clean,
        -- created_at as timestamp (source is string)
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(created_at_raw), '') AS timestamp) AS created_at_ts
    FROM base
)
SELECT
    -- raw passthrough columns (renamed with _raw where we also expose a cleaned version)
    customer_id_raw,
    email,
    first_name_raw,
    last_name_raw,
    created_at_raw,

    -- required raw helper
    email AS email_raw,

    -- cleaned / normalized columns per spec
    customer_id_clean AS customer_id,
    normalized_email,
    is_email_valid,
    first_name_clean  AS first_name,
    last_name_clean   AS last_name,
    created_at_ts     AS created_at,

    -- source table identifier
    'AwsDataCatalog.test_raw.raw_customers' AS source_table,

    -- row-level hash for change detection (limited to available fields)
    TO_HEX(
        MD5(
            to_utf8(
                CONCAT_WS(
                    '|',
                    COALESCE(customer_id_clean, ''),
                    COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(email)), ''),
                    COALESCE(CAST(created_at_ts AS varchar), '')
                )
            )
        )
    ) AS row_hash
FROM clean

This has already resulted in divergent behavior (e.g. `placed_at` being reused as business, update, and ingestion time in orders; `updated_at` and `ingestion_ts` missing entirely from customers in the current SQL).
- Required plan change: Clarify and normalize the lifecycle contract in the implementation_spec before changing any SQL by:
  - Defining, for each entity, which specific raw timestamp(s) back `updated_at`, which back `ingestion_ts`, and what each field is meant to represent (business event time vs load/ingestion time vs last-change time).

{{ config(alias="stg_test_raw_raw_order_items") }}

WITH src AS (
    SELECT
        order_item_id AS order_item_id_raw,
        order_id      AS order_id_raw,
        product_sku,
        quantity      AS quantity_raw,
        unit_price    AS unit_price_raw
    FROM {{ source("test_raw", "raw_order_items") }}
),
typed AS (
    SELECT
        -- raw passthrough
        order_item_id_raw,
        order_id_raw,
        product_sku,
        quantity_raw,
        unit_price_raw,

        -- cleaned / normalized fields
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(TRIM(order_item_id_raw), ''),
            to_hex(
                md5(
                    to_utf8(
                        COALESCE(CAST(order_id_raw AS VARCHAR), '') || '|' ||
                        '' -- line_number not available in schema
                    )
                )
            )
        ) AS order_item_id,

        NULLIF(TRIM(order_id_raw), '') AS order_id,

        NULLIF(TRIM(product_sku), '') AS product_id,

        try_cast(NULLIF(TRIM(quantity_raw), '') AS INTEGER) AS quantity,

        try_cast(NULLIF(TRIM(unit_price_raw), '') AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS unit_price,

        -- _ingest_ts not present in schema; keep nullable placeholder
        CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS ingestion_ts
    FROM src
),
with_amounts AS (
    SELECT
        order_item_id_raw,
        order_id_raw,
        product_sku,
        quantity_raw,
        unit_price_raw,
        order_item_id,
        order_id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        unit_price,
        ingestion_ts,
        CASE
            WHEN quantity IS NOT NULL AND unit_price IS NOT NULL THEN
                CAST(quantity AS DECIMAL(18,4)) * unit_price
            ELSE NULL
        END AS line_amount
    FROM typed
),
final AS (
    SELECT
        -- all raw columns preserved
        order_item_id_raw,
        order_id_raw,
        product_sku,
        quantity_raw,
        unit_price_raw,

        -- silver/cleaned columns
        order_item_id,
        order_id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        unit_price,
        line_amount,
        ingestion_ts,

        'AwsDataCatalog.test_raw.raw_order_items' AS source_table,

        to_hex(
            md5(
                to_utf8(
                    CONCAT_WS(
                        '|',
                        COALESCE(CAST(order_item_id AS VARCHAR), ''),
                        COALESCE(CAST(order_id AS VARCHAR), ''),
                        COALESCE(CAST(product_id AS VARCHAR), ''),
                        COALESCE(CAST(quantity AS VARCHAR), ''),
                        COALESCE(CAST(unit_price AS VARCHAR), '')
                    )
                )
            )
        ) AS row_hash,

        CASE
            WHEN quantity IS NOT NULL AND quantity >= 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE
        END AS is_quantity_non_negative,

        CASE
            WHEN (unit_price IS NULL OR unit_price >= 0)
                 AND (line_amount IS NULL OR line_amount >= 0)
            THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS is_amount_non_negative
    FROM with_amounts
)
SELECT
    order_item_id_raw,
    order_id_raw,
    product_sku,
    quantity_raw,
    unit_price_raw,
    order_item_id,
    order_id,
    product_id,
    quantity,
    unit_price,
    line_amount,
    ingestion_ts,
    source_table,
    row_hash,
    is_quantity_non_negative,
    is_amount_non_negative
FROM final;

- Defect: The spec intends common lifecycle fields (`updated_at`, `ingestion_ts`, and `row_hash`) across customers, orders, and order_items, but (a) the raw sources do not consistently provide timestamps to support these fields, and (b) the spec does not clearly define whether these represent business event time, system update time, or ingestion time. - Required plan change: Clarify and normalize the lifecycle contract in the implementation_spec before changing any SQL by:
  - Defining, for each entity, which specific raw timestamp(s) back `updated_at`, which back `ingestion_ts`, and what each field is meant to represent (business event time vs load/ingestion time vs last-change time).

{{ config(alias="stg_test_raw_raw_orders") }}

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        order_id,
        customer_id,
        order_status,
        total_amount,
        placed_at,
        NULLIF(TRIM(order_id), '')        AS order_id_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(customer_id), '')      AS customer_id_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(order_status), '')     AS order_status_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(total_amount), '')     AS total_amount_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(placed_at), '')        AS placed_at_raw
    FROM {{ source("test_raw", "raw_orders") }}
)
SELECT
    -- Preserve raw columns (renamed to avoid duplicates with cleaned fields)
    base.order_id      AS order_id_raw,
    base.customer_id   AS customer_id_raw,
    base.order_status  AS order_status_raw,
    base.total_amount  AS total_amount_raw,
    base.placed_at     AS placed_at_raw_value,

    -- Cleaned primary order identifier (falls back to hash of customer_id + placed_at when raw order_id is missing/blank)
    COALESCE(
        order_id_str,
        to_hex(md5(to_utf8(COALESCE(customer_id_str, '') || '|' || COALESCE(placed_at_raw, ''))))
    ) AS order_id,

    -- Normalized customer_id
    customer_id_str AS customer_id,

    -- Business order timestamp derived from placed_at
    try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS order_date,

    -- Created-at approximated from placed_at (no dedicated created_at column available)
    try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS created_at,

    -- No updated_at field in source; exposed as NULLable timestamp
    CAST(NULL AS timestamp) AS updated_at,

    -- Normalized order status
    LOWER(order_status_str) AS order_status,

    -- Canonical numeric amount
    try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS total_amount,

    -- No currency field in source; exposed as NULLable string
    CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS currency,

    -- Ingestion timestamp approximated from business order timestamp (no dedicated ingest column)
    try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS ingestion_ts,

    -- Source table identifier
    'AwsDataCatalog.test_raw.raw_orders' AS source_table,

    -- Deterministic row hash for change detection
    to_hex(
        md5(
            to_utf8(
                CONCAT_WS(
                    '|',
                    COALESCE(
                        COALESCE(
                            order_id_str,
                            to_hex(md5(to_utf8(COALESCE(customer_id_str, '') || '|' || COALESCE(placed_at_raw, ''))))
                        ),
                        ''
                    ),
                    COALESCE(customer_id_str, ''),
                    COALESCE(CAST(try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS varchar), ''),
                    COALESCE(CAST(try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS varchar), '')
                )
            )
        )
    ) AS row_hash,

    -- Quality flag for total_amount
    CASE
        WHEN try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) IS NOT NULL
             AND try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) >= 0
        THEN TRUE
        ELSE FALSE
    END AS is_total_amount_non_negative
FROM base

WITH src AS (
    SELECT
        order_item_id AS order_item_id_raw,
        order_id      AS order_id_raw,
        product_sku,
        quantity      AS quantity_raw,
        unit_price    AS unit_price_raw
    FROM {{ source("test_raw", "raw_order_items") }}
),
typed AS (
    SELECT
        -- raw passthrough
        order_item_id_raw,
        order_id_raw,
        product_sku,
        quantity_raw,
        unit_price_raw,

        -- cleaned / normalized fields
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(TRIM(order_item_id_raw), ''),
            to_hex(
                md5(
                    to_utf8(
                        COALESCE(CAST(order_id_raw AS VARCHAR), '') || '|' ||
                        '' -- line_number not available in schema
                    )
                )
            )
        ) AS order_item_id,

        NULLIF(TRIM(order_id_raw), '') AS order_id,

        NULLIF(TRIM(product_sku), '') AS product_id,

        try_cast(NULLIF(TRIM(quantity_raw), '') AS INTEGER) AS quantity,

        try_cast(NULLIF(TRIM(unit_price_raw), '') AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS unit_price,

        -- _ingest_ts not present in schema; keep nullable placeholder
        CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS ingestion_ts
    FROM src
),
with_amounts AS (
    SELECT
        order_item_id_raw,
        order_id_raw,
        product_sku,
        quantity_raw,
        unit_price_raw,
        order_item_id,
        order_id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        unit_price,
        ingestion_ts,
        CASE
            WHEN quantity IS NOT NULL AND unit_price IS NOT NULL THEN
                CAST(quantity AS DECIMAL(18,4)) * unit_price
            ELSE NULL
        END AS line_amount
    FROM typed
),
final AS (
    SELECT
        -- all raw columns preserved
        order_item_id_raw,
        order_id_raw,
        product_sku,
        quantity_raw,
        unit_price_raw,

        -- silver/cleaned columns
        order_item_id,
        order_id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        unit_price,
        line_amount,
        ingestion_ts,

        'AwsDataCatalog.test_raw.raw_order_items' AS source_table,

        to_hex(
            md5(
                to_utf8(
                    CONCAT_WS(
                        '|',
                        COALESCE(CAST(order_item_id AS VARCHAR), ''),
                        COALESCE(CAST(order_id AS VARCHAR), ''),
                        COALESCE(CAST(product_id AS VARCHAR), ''),
                        COALESCE(CAST(quantity AS VARCHAR), ''),
                        COALESCE(CAST(unit_price AS VARCHAR), '')
                    )
                )
            )
        ) AS row_hash,

        CASE
            WHEN quantity IS NOT NULL AND quantity >= 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE
        END AS is_quantity_non_negative,

        CASE
            WHEN (unit_price IS NULL OR unit_price >= 0)
                 AND (line_amount IS NULL OR line_amount >= 0)
            THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS is_amount_non_negative
    FROM with_amounts
)
SELECT
    order_item_id_raw,
    order_id_raw,
    product_sku,
    quantity_raw,
    unit_price_raw,
    order_item_id,
    order_id,
    product_id,
    quantity,
    unit_price,
    line_amount,
    ingestion_ts,
    source_table,
    row_hash,
    is_quantity_non_negative,
    is_amount_non_negative
FROM final;

{{ config(alias="stg_test_raw_raw_orders") }}

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        order_id,
        customer_id,
        order_status,
        total_amount,
        placed_at,
        NULLIF(TRIM(order_id), '')        AS order_id_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(customer_id), '')      AS customer_id_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(order_status), '')     AS order_status_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(total_amount), '')     AS total_amount_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(placed_at), '')        AS placed_at_raw
    FROM {{ source("test_raw", "raw_orders") }}
)
SELECT
    -- Preserve raw columns (renamed to avoid duplicates with cleaned fields)
    base.order_id      AS order_id_raw,
    base.customer_id   AS customer_id_raw,
    base.order_status  AS order_status_raw,
    base.total_amount  AS total_amount_raw,
    base.placed_at     AS placed_at_raw_value,

    -- Cleaned primary order identifier (falls back to hash of customer_id + placed_at when raw order_id is missing/blank)
    COALESCE(
        order_id_str,
        to_hex(md5(to_utf8(COALESCE(customer_id_str, '') || '|' || COALESCE(placed_at_raw, ''))))
    ) AS order_id,

    -- Normalized customer_id
    customer_id_str AS customer_id,

    -- Business order timestamp derived from placed_at
    try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS order_date,

    -- Created-at approximated from placed_at (no dedicated created_at column available)
    try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS created_at,

    -- No updated_at field in source; exposed as NULLable timestamp
    CAST(NULL AS timestamp) AS updated_at,

    -- Normalized order status
    LOWER(order_status_str) AS order_status,

    -- Canonical numeric amount
    try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS total_amount,

    -- No currency field in source; exposed as NULLable string
    CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS currency,

    -- Ingestion timestamp approximated from business order timestamp (no dedicated ingest column)
    try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS ingestion_ts,

    -- Source table identifier
    'AwsDataCatalog.test_raw.raw_orders' AS source_table,

    -- Deterministic row hash for change detection
    to_hex(
        md5(
            to_utf8(
                CONCAT_WS(
                    '|',
                    COALESCE(
                        COALESCE(
                            order_id_str,
                            to_hex(md5(to_utf8(COALESCE(customer_id_str, '') || '|' || COALESCE(placed_at_raw, ''))))
                        ),
                        ''
                    ),
                    COALESCE(customer_id_str, ''),
                    COALESCE(CAST(try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS varchar), ''),
                    COALESCE(CAST(try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS varchar), '')
                )
            )
        )
    ) AS row_hash,

    -- Quality flag for total_amount
    CASE
        WHEN try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) IS NOT NULL
             AND try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) >= 0
        THEN TRUE
        ELSE FALSE
    END AS is_total_amount_non_negative
FROM base

{{ config(alias="stg_test_raw_raw_orders") }}

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        order_id,
        customer_id,
        order_status,
        total_amount,
        placed_at,
        NULLIF(TRIM(order_id), '')        AS order_id_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(customer_id), '')      AS customer_id_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(order_status), '')     AS order_status_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(total_amount), '')     AS total_amount_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(placed_at), '')        AS placed_at_raw
    FROM {{ source("test_raw", "raw_orders") }}
)
SELECT
    -- Preserve raw columns (renamed to avoid duplicates with cleaned fields)
    base.order_id      AS order_id_raw,
    base.customer_id   AS customer_id_raw,
    base.order_status  AS order_status_raw,
    base.total_amount  AS total_amount_raw,
    base.placed_at     AS placed_at_raw_value,

    -- Cleaned primary order identifier (falls back to hash of customer_id + placed_at when raw order_id is missing/blank)
    COALESCE(
        order_id_str,
        to_hex(md5(to_utf8(COALESCE(customer_id_str, '') || '|' || COALESCE(placed_at_raw, ''))))
    ) AS order_id,

    -- Normalized customer_id
    customer_id_str AS customer_id,

    -- Business order timestamp derived from placed_at
    try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS order_date,

    -- Created-at approximated from placed_at (no dedicated created_at column available)
    try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS created_at,

    -- No updated_at field in source; exposed as NULLable timestamp
    CAST(NULL AS timestamp) AS updated_at,

    -- Normalized order status
    LOWER(order_status_str) AS order_status,

    -- Canonical numeric amount
    try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS total_amount,

    -- No currency field in source; exposed as NULLable string
    CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS currency,

    -- Ingestion timestamp approximated from business order timestamp (no dedicated ingest column)
    try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS ingestion_ts,

    -- Source table identifier
    'AwsDataCatalog.test_raw.raw_orders' AS source_table,

    -- Deterministic row hash for change detection
    to_hex(
        md5(
            to_utf8(
                CONCAT_WS(
                    '|',
                    COALESCE(
                        COALESCE(
                            order_id_str,
                            to_hex(md5(to_utf8(COALESCE(customer_id_str, '') || '|' || COALESCE(placed_at_raw, ''))))
                        ),
                        ''
                    ),
                    COALESCE(customer_id_str, ''),
                    COALESCE(CAST(try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS varchar), ''),
                    COALESCE(CAST(try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS varchar), '')
                )
            )
        )
    ) AS row_hash,

    -- Quality flag for total_amount
    CASE
        WHEN try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) IS NOT NULL
             AND try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) >= 0
        THEN TRUE
        ELSE FALSE
    END AS is_total_amount_non_negative
FROM base

{{ config(alias="stg_test_raw_raw_customers") }}

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id       AS customer_id_raw,
        email,
        first_name        AS first_name_raw,
        last_name         AS last_name_raw,
        created_at        AS created_at_raw
    FROM {{ source("test_raw", "raw_customers") }}
),
clean AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id_raw,
        email,
        first_name_raw,
        last_name_raw,
        created_at_raw,
        -- cleaned customer_id (prefers raw customer_id; falls back to hash of email + names)
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(CAST(customer_id_raw AS varchar), ''),
            TO_HEX(
                MD5(
                    to_utf8(
                        CONCAT(
                            COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(email)), ''),
                            '|',
                            COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(first_name_raw)), ''),
                            '|',
                            COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(last_name_raw)), '')
                        )
                    )
                )
            )
        ) AS customer_id_clean,
        -- normalized email + validity flag
        CASE
            WHEN email IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(TRIM(email)), '^[^@\\s]+@[^@\\s]+\\.[^@\\s]+$')
                THEN LOWER(TRIM(email))
            ELSE NULL
        END AS normalized_email,
        CASE
            WHEN email IS NULL THEN FALSE
            WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(TRIM(email)), '^[^@\\s]+@[^@\\s]+\\.[^@\\s]+$')
                THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS is_email_valid,
        -- cleaned names
        NULLIF(TRIM(first_name_raw), '') AS first_name_clean,
        NULLIF(TRIM(last_name_raw), '')  AS last_name_clean,
        -- created_at as timestamp (source is string)
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(created_at_raw), '') AS timestamp) AS created_at_ts
    FROM base
)
SELECT
    -- raw passthrough columns (renamed with _raw where we also expose a cleaned version)
    customer_id_raw,
    email,
    first_name_raw,
    last_name_raw,
    created_at_raw,

    -- required raw helper
    email AS email_raw,

    -- cleaned / normalized columns per spec
    customer_id_clean AS customer_id,
    normalized_email,
    is_email_valid,
    first_name_clean  AS first_name,
    last_name_clean   AS last_name,
    created_at_ts     AS created_at,

    -- source table identifier
    'AwsDataCatalog.test_raw.raw_customers' AS source_table,

    -- row-level hash for change detection (limited to available fields)
    TO_HEX(
        MD5(
            to_utf8(
                CONCAT_WS(
                    '|',
                    COALESCE(customer_id_clean, ''),
                    COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(email)), ''),
                    COALESCE(CAST(created_at_ts AS varchar), '')
                )
            )
        )
    ) AS row_hash
FROM clean

{{ config(alias="stg_test_raw_raw_order_items") }}

WITH src AS (
    SELECT
        order_item_id AS order_item_id_raw,
        order_id      AS order_id_raw,
        product_sku,
        quantity      AS quantity_raw,
        unit_price    AS unit_price_raw
    FROM {{ source("test_raw", "raw_order_items") }}
),
typed AS (
    SELECT
        -- raw passthrough
        order_item_id_raw,
        order_id_raw,
        product_sku,
        quantity_raw,
        unit_price_raw,

        -- cleaned / normalized fields
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(TRIM(order_item_id_raw), ''),
            to_hex(
                md5(
                    to_utf8(
                        COALESCE(CAST(order_id_raw AS VARCHAR), '') || '|' ||
                        '' -- line_number not available in schema
                    )
                )
            )
        ) AS order_item_id,

        NULLIF(TRIM(order_id_raw), '') AS order_id,

        NULLIF(TRIM(product_sku), '') AS product_id,

        try_cast(NULLIF(TRIM(quantity_raw), '') AS INTEGER) AS quantity,

        try_cast(NULLIF(TRIM(unit_price_raw), '') AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS unit_price,

        -- _ingest_ts not present in schema; keep nullable placeholder
        CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS ingestion_ts
    FROM src
),
with_amounts AS (
    SELECT
        order_item_id_raw,
        order_id_raw,
        product_sku,
        quantity_raw,
        unit_price_raw,
        order_item_id,
        order_id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        unit_price,
        ingestion_ts,
        CASE
            WHEN quantity IS NOT NULL AND unit_price IS NOT NULL THEN
                CAST(quantity AS DECIMAL(18,4)) * unit_price
            ELSE NULL
        END AS line_amount
    FROM typed
),
final AS (
    SELECT
        -- all raw columns preserved
        order_item_id_raw,
        order_id_raw,
        product_sku,
        quantity_raw,
        unit_price_raw,

        -- silver/cleaned columns
        order_item_id,
        order_id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        unit_price,
        line_amount,
        ingestion_ts,

        'AwsDataCatalog.test_raw.raw_order_items' AS source_table,

        to_hex(
            md5(
                to_utf8(
                    CONCAT_WS(
                        '|',
                        COALESCE(CAST(order_item_id AS VARCHAR), ''),
                        COALESCE(CAST(order_id AS VARCHAR), ''),
                        COALESCE(CAST(product_id AS VARCHAR), ''),
                        COALESCE(CAST(quantity AS VARCHAR), ''),
                        COALESCE(CAST(unit_price AS VARCHAR), '')
                    )
                )
            )
        ) AS row_hash,

        CASE
            WHEN quantity IS NOT NULL AND quantity >= 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE
        END AS is_quantity_non_negative,

        CASE
            WHEN (unit_price IS NULL OR unit_price >= 0)
                 AND (line_amount IS NULL OR line_amount >= 0)
            THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS is_amount_non_negative
    FROM with_amounts
)
SELECT
    order_item_id_raw,
    order_id_raw,
    product_sku,
    quantity_raw,
    unit_price_raw,
    order_item_id,
    order_id,
    product_id,
    quantity,
    unit_price,
    line_amount,
    ingestion_ts,
    source_table,
    row_hash,
    is_quantity_non_negative,
    is_amount_non_negative
FROM final;

        COALESCE(

            TO_HEX(
                MD5(
                    to_utf8(
                        CONCAT(
                            COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(email)), ''),
                            '|',

                            '|',
                            COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(last_name_raw)), '')

                THEN LOWER(TRIM(email))

WITH src AS (
    SELECT
        order_item_id AS order_item_id_raw,
        order_id      AS order_id_raw,
        product_sku,
        quantity      AS quantity_raw,
        unit_price    AS unit_price_raw
    FROM {{ source("test_raw", "raw_order_items") }}
),
typed AS (
    SELECT
        -- raw passthrough
        order_item_id_raw,
        order_id_raw,
        product_sku,
        quantity_raw,
        unit_price_raw,

        -- cleaned / normalized fields
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(TRIM(order_item_id_raw), ''),
            to_hex(
                md5(
                    to_utf8(
                        COALESCE(CAST(order_id_raw AS VARCHAR), '') || '|' ||
                        '' -- line_number not available in schema
                    )
                )
            )
        ) AS order_item_id,

        NULLIF(TRIM(order_id_raw), '') AS order_id,

        NULLIF(TRIM(product_sku), '') AS product_id,

        try_cast(NULLIF(TRIM(quantity_raw), '') AS INTEGER) AS quantity,

        try_cast(NULLIF(TRIM(unit_price_raw), '') AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS unit_price,

        -- _ingest_ts not present in schema; keep nullable placeholder
        CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS ingestion_ts
    FROM src
),
with_amounts AS (
    SELECT
        order_item_id_raw,
        order_id_raw,
        product_sku,
        quantity_raw,
        unit_price_raw,
        order_item_id,
        order_id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        unit_price,
        ingestion_ts,
        CASE
            WHEN quantity IS NOT NULL AND unit_price IS NOT NULL THEN
                CAST(quantity AS DECIMAL(18,4)) * unit_price
            ELSE NULL
        END AS line_amount
    FROM typed
),
final AS (
    SELECT
        -- all raw columns preserved
        order_item_id_raw,
        order_id_raw,
        product_sku,
        quantity_raw,
        unit_price_raw,

        -- silver/cleaned columns
        order_item_id,
        order_id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        unit_price,
        line_amount,
        ingestion_ts,

        'AwsDataCatalog.test_raw.raw_order_items' AS source_table,

        to_hex(
            md5(
                to_utf8(
                    CONCAT_WS(
                        '|',
                        COALESCE(CAST(order_item_id AS VARCHAR), ''),
                        COALESCE(CAST(order_id AS VARCHAR), ''),
                        COALESCE(CAST(product_id AS VARCHAR), ''),
                        COALESCE(CAST(quantity AS VARCHAR), ''),
                        COALESCE(CAST(unit_price AS VARCHAR), '')
                    )
                )
            )
        ) AS row_hash,

        CASE
            WHEN quantity IS NOT NULL AND quantity >= 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE
        END AS is_quantity_non_negative,

        CASE
            WHEN (unit_price IS NULL OR unit_price >= 0)
                 AND (line_amount IS NULL OR line_amount >= 0)
            THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS is_amount_non_negative
    FROM with_amounts
)
SELECT
    order_item_id_raw,
    order_id_raw,
    product_sku,
    quantity_raw,
    unit_price_raw,
    order_item_id,
    order_id,
    product_id,
    quantity,
    unit_price,
    line_amount,
    ingestion_ts,
    source_table,
    row_hash,
    is_quantity_non_negative,
    is_amount_non_negative
FROM final;

{{ config(alias="stg_test_raw_raw_orders") }}

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        order_id,
        customer_id,
        order_status,
        total_amount,
        placed_at,
        NULLIF(TRIM(order_id), '')        AS order_id_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(customer_id), '')      AS customer_id_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(order_status), '')     AS order_status_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(total_amount), '')     AS total_amount_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(placed_at), '')        AS placed_at_raw
    FROM {{ source("test_raw", "raw_orders") }}
)
SELECT
    -- Preserve raw columns (renamed to avoid duplicates with cleaned fields)
    base.order_id      AS order_id_raw,
    base.customer_id   AS customer_id_raw,
    base.order_status  AS order_status_raw,
    base.total_amount  AS total_amount_raw,
    base.placed_at     AS placed_at_raw_value,

    -- Cleaned primary order identifier (falls back to hash of customer_id + placed_at when raw order_id is missing/blank)
    COALESCE(
        order_id_str,
        to_hex(md5(to_utf8(COALESCE(customer_id_str, '') || '|' || COALESCE(placed_at_raw, ''))))
    ) AS order_id,

    -- Normalized customer_id
    customer_id_str AS customer_id,

    -- Business order timestamp derived from placed_at
    try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS order_date,

    -- Created-at approximated from placed_at (no dedicated created_at column available)
    try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS created_at,

    -- No updated_at field in source; exposed as NULLable timestamp
    CAST(NULL AS timestamp) AS updated_at,

    -- Normalized order status
    LOWER(order_status_str) AS order_status,

    -- Canonical numeric amount
    try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS total_amount,

    -- No currency field in source; exposed as NULLable string
    CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS currency,

    -- Ingestion timestamp approximated from business order timestamp (no dedicated ingest column)
    try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS ingestion_ts,

    -- Source table identifier
    'AwsDataCatalog.test_raw.raw_orders' AS source_table,

    -- Deterministic row hash for change detection
    to_hex(
        md5(
            to_utf8(
                CONCAT_WS(
                    '|',
                    COALESCE(
                        COALESCE(
                            order_id_str,
                            to_hex(md5(to_utf8(COALESCE(customer_id_str, '') || '|' || COALESCE(placed_at_raw, ''))))
                        ),
                        ''
                    ),
                    COALESCE(customer_id_str, ''),
                    COALESCE(CAST(try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS varchar), ''),
                    COALESCE(CAST(try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS varchar), '')
                )
            )
        )
    ) AS row_hash,

    -- Quality flag for total_amount
    CASE
        WHEN try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) IS NOT NULL
             AND try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) >= 0
        THEN TRUE
        ELSE FALSE
    END AS is_total_amount_non_negative
FROM base

WITH src AS (
    SELECT
        order_item_id AS order_item_id_raw,

        product_sku,
        quantity      AS quantity_raw,

),
typed AS (
    SELECT
        -- raw passthrough
        order_item_id_raw,
        order_id_raw,
        product_sku,
        quantity_raw,
        unit_price_raw,

        -- cleaned / normalized fields
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(TRIM(order_item_id_raw), ''),
            to_hex(
                md5(
                    to_utf8(
                        COALESCE(CAST(order_id_raw AS VARCHAR), '') || '|' ||
                        '' -- line_number not available in schema
                    )
                )
            )
        ) AS order_item_id,

        NULLIF(TRIM(order_id_raw), '') AS order_id,

        NULLIF(TRIM(product_sku), '') AS product_id,

        try_cast(NULLIF(TRIM(quantity_raw), '') AS INTEGER) AS quantity,

        try_cast(NULLIF(TRIM(unit_price_raw), '') AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS unit_price,

        -- _ingest_ts not present in schema; keep nullable placeholder
        CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS ingestion_ts
    FROM src
),
with_amounts AS (
    SELECT
        order_item_id_raw,
        order_id_raw,
        product_sku,
        quantity_raw,
        unit_price_raw,
        order_item_id,
        order_id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        unit_price,
        ingestion_ts,
        CASE
            WHEN quantity IS NOT NULL AND unit_price IS NOT NULL THEN
                CAST(quantity AS DECIMAL(18,4)) * unit_price
            ELSE NULL
        END AS line_amount
    FROM typed
),
final AS (
    SELECT
        -- all raw columns preserved
        order_item_id_raw,
        order_id_raw,
        product_sku,
        quantity_raw,
        unit_price_raw,

        -- silver/cleaned columns
        order_item_id,
        order_id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        unit_price,
        line_amount,
        ingestion_ts,

        'AwsDataCatalog.test_raw.raw_order_items' AS source_table,

        to_hex(
            md5(
                to_utf8(
                    CONCAT_WS(
                        '|',
                        COALESCE(CAST(order_item_id AS VARCHAR), ''),
                        COALESCE(CAST(order_id AS VARCHAR), ''),
                        COALESCE(CAST(product_id AS VARCHAR), ''),
                        COALESCE(CAST(quantity AS VARCHAR), ''),
                        COALESCE(CAST(unit_price AS VARCHAR), '')
                    )
                )
            )
        ) AS row_hash,

        CASE
            WHEN quantity IS NOT NULL AND quantity >= 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE
        END AS is_quantity_non_negative,

        CASE
            WHEN (unit_price IS NULL OR unit_price >= 0)
                 AND (line_amount IS NULL OR line_amount >= 0)
            THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS is_amount_non_negative
    FROM with_amounts
)
SELECT
    order_item_id_raw,
    order_id_raw,
    product_sku,
    quantity_raw,
    unit_price_raw,
    order_item_id,
    order_id,
    product_id,
    quantity,
    unit_price,
    line_amount,
    ingestion_ts,
    source_table,
    row_hash,
    is_quantity_non_negative,
    is_amount_non_negative
FROM final;

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        order_id,
        customer_id,
        order_status,
        total_amount,
        placed_at,
        NULLIF(TRIM(order_id), '')        AS order_id_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(customer_id), '')      AS customer_id_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(order_status), '')     AS order_status_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(total_amount), '')     AS total_amount_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(placed_at), '')        AS placed_at_raw
    FROM {{ source("test_raw", "raw_orders") }}
)
SELECT
    -- Preserve raw columns (renamed to avoid duplicates with cleaned fields)
    base.order_id      AS order_id_raw,
    base.customer_id   AS customer_id_raw,
    base.order_status  AS order_status_raw,
    base.total_amount  AS total_amount_raw,
    base.placed_at     AS placed_at_raw_value,

    -- Cleaned primary order identifier (falls back to hash of customer_id + placed_at when raw order_id is missing/blank)
    COALESCE(
        order_id_str,
        to_hex(md5(to_utf8(COALESCE(customer_id_str, '') || '|' || COALESCE(placed_at_raw, ''))))
    ) AS order_id,

    -- Normalized customer_id
    customer_id_str AS customer_id,

    -- Business order timestamp derived from placed_at
    try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS order_date,

    -- Created-at approximated from placed_at (no dedicated created_at column available)
    try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS created_at,

    -- No updated_at field in source; exposed as NULLable timestamp
    CAST(NULL AS timestamp) AS updated_at,

    -- Normalized order status
    LOWER(order_status_str) AS order_status,

    -- Canonical numeric amount
    try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS total_amount,

    -- No currency field in source; exposed as NULLable string
    CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS currency,

    -- Ingestion timestamp approximated from business order timestamp (no dedicated ingest column)
    try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS ingestion_ts,

    -- Source table identifier
    'AwsDataCatalog.test_raw.raw_orders' AS source_table,

    -- Deterministic row hash for change detection
    to_hex(
        md5(
            to_utf8(
                CONCAT_WS(
                    '|',
                    COALESCE(
                        COALESCE(
                            order_id_str,
                            to_hex(md5(to_utf8(COALESCE(customer_id_str, '') || '|' || COALESCE(placed_at_raw, ''))))
                        ),
                        ''
                    ),
                    COALESCE(customer_id_str, ''),
                    COALESCE(CAST(try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS varchar), ''),
                    COALESCE(CAST(try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS varchar), '')
                )
            )
        )
    ) AS row_hash,

    -- Quality flag for total_amount
    CASE
        WHEN try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) IS NOT NULL
             AND try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) >= 0
        THEN TRUE
        ELSE FALSE
    END AS is_total_amount_non_negative
FROM base

{{ config(alias="stg_test_raw_raw_customers") }}

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id       AS customer_id_raw,
        email,
        first_name        AS first_name_raw,
        last_name         AS last_name_raw,
        created_at        AS created_at_raw
    FROM {{ source("test_raw", "raw_customers") }}
),
clean AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id_raw,
        email,
        first_name_raw,
        last_name_raw,
        created_at_raw,
        -- cleaned customer_id (prefers raw customer_id; falls back to hash of email + names)
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(CAST(customer_id_raw AS varchar), ''),
            TO_HEX(
                MD5(
                    to_utf8(
                        CONCAT(
                            COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(email)), ''),
                            '|',
                            COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(first_name_raw)), ''),
                            '|',
                            COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(last_name_raw)), '')
                        )
                    )
                )
            )
        ) AS customer_id_clean,
        -- normalized email + validity flag
        CASE
            WHEN email IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(TRIM(email)), '^[^@\\s]+@[^@\\s]+\\.[^@\\s]+$')
                THEN LOWER(TRIM(email))
            ELSE NULL
        END AS normalized_email,
        CASE
            WHEN email IS NULL THEN FALSE
            WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(TRIM(email)), '^[^@\\s]+@[^@\\s]+\\.[^@\\s]+$')
                THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS is_email_valid,
        -- cleaned names
        NULLIF(TRIM(first_name_raw), '') AS first_name_clean,
        NULLIF(TRIM(last_name_raw), '')  AS last_name_clean,
        -- created_at as timestamp (source is string)
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(created_at_raw), '') AS timestamp) AS created_at_ts
    FROM base
)
SELECT
    -- raw passthrough columns (renamed with _raw where we also expose a cleaned version)
    customer_id_raw,
    email,
    first_name_raw,
    last_name_raw,
    created_at_raw,

    -- required raw helper
    email AS email_raw,

    -- cleaned / normalized columns per spec
    customer_id_clean AS customer_id,
    normalized_email,
    is_email_valid,
    first_name_clean  AS first_name,
    last_name_clean   AS last_name,
    created_at_ts     AS created_at,

    -- source table identifier
    'AwsDataCatalog.test_raw.raw_customers' AS source_table,

    -- row-level hash for change detection (limited to available fields)
    TO_HEX(
        MD5(
            to_utf8(
                CONCAT_WS(
                    '|',
                    COALESCE(customer_id_clean, ''),
                    COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(email)), ''),
                    COALESCE(CAST(created_at_ts AS varchar), '')
                )
            )
        )
    ) AS row_hash
FROM clean

{{ config(alias="stg_test_raw_raw_orders") }}

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        order_id,
        customer_id,
        order_status,
        total_amount,
        placed_at,
        NULLIF(TRIM(order_id), '')        AS order_id_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(customer_id), '')      AS customer_id_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(order_status), '')     AS order_status_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(total_amount), '')     AS total_amount_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(placed_at), '')        AS placed_at_raw
    FROM {{ source("test_raw", "raw_orders") }}
)
SELECT
    -- Preserve raw columns (renamed to avoid duplicates with cleaned fields)
    base.order_id      AS order_id_raw,
    base.customer_id   AS customer_id_raw,
    base.order_status  AS order_status_raw,
    base.total_amount  AS total_amount_raw,
    base.placed_at     AS placed_at_raw_value,

    -- Cleaned primary order identifier (falls back to hash of customer_id + placed_at when raw order_id is missing/blank)
    COALESCE(
        order_id_str,
        to_hex(md5(to_utf8(COALESCE(customer_id_str, '') || '|' || COALESCE(placed_at_raw, ''))))
    ) AS order_id,

    -- Normalized customer_id
    customer_id_str AS customer_id,

    -- Business order timestamp derived from placed_at
    try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS order_date,

    -- Created-at approximated from placed_at (no dedicated created_at column available)
    try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS created_at,

    -- No updated_at field in source; exposed as NULLable timestamp
    CAST(NULL AS timestamp) AS updated_at,

    -- Normalized order status
    LOWER(order_status_str) AS order_status,

    -- Canonical numeric amount
    try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS total_amount,

    -- No currency field in source; exposed as NULLable string
    CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS currency,

    -- Ingestion timestamp approximated from business order timestamp (no dedicated ingest column)
    try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS ingestion_ts,

    -- Source table identifier
    'AwsDataCatalog.test_raw.raw_orders' AS source_table,

    -- Deterministic row hash for change detection
    to_hex(
        md5(
            to_utf8(
                CONCAT_WS(
                    '|',
                    COALESCE(
                        COALESCE(
                            order_id_str,
                            to_hex(md5(to_utf8(COALESCE(customer_id_str, '') || '|' || COALESCE(placed_at_raw, ''))))
                        ),
                        ''
                    ),
                    COALESCE(customer_id_str, ''),
                    COALESCE(CAST(try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS varchar), ''),
                    COALESCE(CAST(try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS varchar), '')
                )
            )
        )
    ) AS row_hash,

    -- Quality flag for total_amount
    CASE
        WHEN try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) IS NOT NULL
             AND try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) >= 0
        THEN TRUE
        ELSE FALSE
    END AS is_total_amount_non_negative
FROM base

WITH src AS (
    SELECT
        order_item_id AS order_item_id_raw,
        order_id      AS order_id_raw,
        product_sku,
        quantity      AS quantity_raw,
        unit_price    AS unit_price_raw
    FROM {{ source("test_raw", "raw_order_items") }}
),
typed AS (
    SELECT
        -- raw passthrough
        order_item_id_raw,
        order_id_raw,
        product_sku,
        quantity_raw,
        unit_price_raw,

        -- cleaned / normalized fields
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(TRIM(order_item_id_raw), ''),
            to_hex(
                md5(
                    to_utf8(
                        COALESCE(CAST(order_id_raw AS VARCHAR), '') || '|' ||
                        '' -- line_number not available in schema
                    )
                )
            )
        ) AS order_item_id,

        NULLIF(TRIM(order_id_raw), '') AS order_id,

        NULLIF(TRIM(product_sku), '') AS product_id,

        try_cast(NULLIF(TRIM(quantity_raw), '') AS INTEGER) AS quantity,

        try_cast(NULLIF(TRIM(unit_price_raw), '') AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS unit_price,

        -- _ingest_ts not present in schema; keep nullable placeholder
        CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS ingestion_ts
    FROM src
),
with_amounts AS (
    SELECT
        order_item_id_raw,
        order_id_raw,
        product_sku,
        quantity_raw,
        unit_price_raw,
        order_item_id,
        order_id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        unit_price,
        ingestion_ts,
        CASE
            WHEN quantity IS NOT NULL AND unit_price IS NOT NULL THEN
                CAST(quantity AS DECIMAL(18,4)) * unit_price
            ELSE NULL
        END AS line_amount
    FROM typed
),
final AS (
    SELECT
        -- all raw columns preserved
        order_item_id_raw,
        order_id_raw,
        product_sku,
        quantity_raw,
        unit_price_raw,

        -- silver/cleaned columns
        order_item_id,
        order_id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        unit_price,
        line_amount,
        ingestion_ts,

        'AwsDataCatalog.test_raw.raw_order_items' AS source_table,

        to_hex(
            md5(
                to_utf8(
                    CONCAT_WS(
                        '|',
                        COALESCE(CAST(order_item_id AS VARCHAR), ''),
                        COALESCE(CAST(order_id AS VARCHAR), ''),
                        COALESCE(CAST(product_id AS VARCHAR), ''),
                        COALESCE(CAST(quantity AS VARCHAR), ''),
                        COALESCE(CAST(unit_price AS VARCHAR), '')
                    )
                )
            )
        ) AS row_hash,

        CASE
            WHEN quantity IS NOT NULL AND quantity >= 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE
        END AS is_quantity_non_negative,

        CASE
            WHEN (unit_price IS NULL OR unit_price >= 0)
                 AND (line_amount IS NULL OR line_amount >= 0)
            THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS is_amount_non_negative
    FROM with_amounts
)
SELECT
    order_item_id_raw,
    order_id_raw,
    product_sku,
    quantity_raw,
    unit_price_raw,
    order_item_id,
    order_id,
    product_id,
    quantity,
    unit_price,
    line_amount,
    ingestion_ts,
    source_table,
    row_hash,
    is_quantity_non_negative,
    is_amount_non_negative
FROM final;

{{ config(alias="stg_test_raw_raw_customers") }}

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id       AS customer_id_raw,
        email,
        first_name        AS first_name_raw,
        last_name         AS last_name_raw,
        created_at        AS created_at_raw
    FROM {{ source("test_raw", "raw_customers") }}
),
clean AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id_raw,
        email,
        first_name_raw,
        last_name_raw,
        created_at_raw,
        -- cleaned customer_id (prefers raw customer_id; falls back to hash of email + names)
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(CAST(customer_id_raw AS varchar), ''),
            TO_HEX(
                MD5(
                    to_utf8(
                        CONCAT(
                            COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(email)), ''),
                            '|',
                            COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(first_name_raw)), ''),
                            '|',
                            COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(last_name_raw)), '')
                        )
                    )
                )
            )
        ) AS customer_id_clean,
        -- normalized email + validity flag
        CASE
            WHEN email IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(TRIM(email)), '^[^@\\s]+@[^@\\s]+\\.[^@\\s]+$')
                THEN LOWER(TRIM(email))
            ELSE NULL
        END AS normalized_email,
        CASE
            WHEN email IS NULL THEN FALSE
            WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(TRIM(email)), '^[^@\\s]+@[^@\\s]+\\.[^@\\s]+$')
                THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS is_email_valid,
        -- cleaned names
        NULLIF(TRIM(first_name_raw), '') AS first_name_clean,
        NULLIF(TRIM(last_name_raw), '')  AS last_name_clean,
        -- created_at as timestamp (source is string)
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(created_at_raw), '') AS timestamp) AS created_at_ts
    FROM base
)
SELECT
    -- raw passthrough columns (renamed with _raw where we also expose a cleaned version)
    customer_id_raw,
    email,
    first_name_raw,
    last_name_raw,
    created_at_raw,

    -- required raw helper
    email AS email_raw,

    -- cleaned / normalized columns per spec
    customer_id_clean AS customer_id,
    normalized_email,
    is_email_valid,
    first_name_clean  AS first_name,
    last_name_clean   AS last_name,
    created_at_ts     AS created_at,

    -- source table identifier
    'AwsDataCatalog.test_raw.raw_customers' AS source_table,

    -- row-level hash for change detection (limited to available fields)
    TO_HEX(
        MD5(
            to_utf8(
                CONCAT_WS(
                    '|',
                    COALESCE(customer_id_clean, ''),
                    COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(email)), ''),
                    COALESCE(CAST(created_at_ts AS varchar), '')
                )
            )
        )
    ) AS row_hash
FROM clean

{{ config(alias="stg_test_raw_raw_orders") }}

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        order_id,
        customer_id,
        order_status,
        total_amount,
        placed_at,
        NULLIF(TRIM(order_id), '')        AS order_id_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(customer_id), '')      AS customer_id_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(order_status), '')     AS order_status_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(total_amount), '')     AS total_amount_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(placed_at), '')        AS placed_at_raw
    FROM {{ source("test_raw", "raw_orders") }}
)
SELECT
    -- Preserve raw columns (renamed to avoid duplicates with cleaned fields)
    base.order_id      AS order_id_raw,
    base.customer_id   AS customer_id_raw,
    base.order_status  AS order_status_raw,
    base.total_amount  AS total_amount_raw,
    base.placed_at     AS placed_at_raw_value,

    -- Cleaned primary order identifier (falls back to hash of customer_id + placed_at when raw order_id is missing/blank)
    COALESCE(
        order_id_str,
        to_hex(md5(to_utf8(COALESCE(customer_id_str, '') || '|' || COALESCE(placed_at_raw, ''))))
    ) AS order_id,

    -- Normalized customer_id
    customer_id_str AS customer_id,

    -- Business order timestamp derived from placed_at
    try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS order_date,

    -- Created-at approximated from placed_at (no dedicated created_at column available)
    try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS created_at,

    -- No updated_at field in source; exposed as NULLable timestamp
    CAST(NULL AS timestamp) AS updated_at,

    -- Normalized order status
    LOWER(order_status_str) AS order_status,

    -- Canonical numeric amount
    try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS total_amount,

    -- No currency field in source; exposed as NULLable string
    CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS currency,

    -- Ingestion timestamp approximated from business order timestamp (no dedicated ingest column)
    try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS ingestion_ts,

    -- Source table identifier
    'AwsDataCatalog.test_raw.raw_orders' AS source_table,

    -- Deterministic row hash for change detection
    to_hex(
        md5(
            to_utf8(
                CONCAT_WS(
                    '|',
                    COALESCE(
                        COALESCE(
                            order_id_str,
                            to_hex(md5(to_utf8(COALESCE(customer_id_str, '') || '|' || COALESCE(placed_at_raw, ''))))
                        ),
                        ''
                    ),
                    COALESCE(customer_id_str, ''),
                    COALESCE(CAST(try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS varchar), ''),
                    COALESCE(CAST(try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS varchar), '')
                )
            )
        )
    ) AS row_hash,

    -- Quality flag for total_amount
    CASE
        WHEN try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) IS NOT NULL
             AND try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) >= 0
        THEN TRUE
        ELSE FALSE
    END AS is_total_amount_non_negative
FROM base

- Defect: The spec intends common lifecycle fields (`updated_at`, `ingestion_ts`, and `row_hash`) across customers, orders, and order_items, but (a) the raw sources do not consistently provide timestamps to support these fields, and (b) the spec does not clearly define whether these represent business event time, system update time, or ingestion time. This has already resulted in divergent behavior (e.g. `placed_at` being reused as business, update, and ingestion time in orders; `updated_at` and `ingestion_ts` missing entirely from customers in the current SQL).
- Required plan change: Clarify and normalize the lifecycle contract in the implementation_spec before changing any SQL by:
  - Defining, for each entity, which specific raw timestamp(s) back `updated_at`, which back `ingestion_ts`, and what each field is meant to represent (business event time vs load/ingestion time vs last-change time).

{{ config(alias="stg_test_raw_raw_orders") }}

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        order_id,
        customer_id,
        order_status,
        total_amount,
        placed_at,
        NULLIF(TRIM(order_id), '')        AS order_id_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(customer_id), '')      AS customer_id_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(order_status), '')     AS order_status_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(total_amount), '')     AS total_amount_str,
        NULLIF(TRIM(placed_at), '')        AS placed_at_raw
    FROM {{ source("test_raw", "raw_orders") }}
)
SELECT
    -- Preserve raw columns (renamed to avoid duplicates with cleaned fields)
    base.order_id      AS order_id_raw,
    base.customer_id   AS customer_id_raw,
    base.order_status  AS order_status_raw,
    base.total_amount  AS total_amount_raw,
    base.placed_at     AS placed_at_raw_value,

    -- Cleaned primary order identifier (falls back to hash of customer_id + placed_at when raw order_id is missing/blank)
    COALESCE(
        order_id_str,
        to_hex(md5(to_utf8(COALESCE(customer_id_str, '') || '|' || COALESCE(placed_at_raw, ''))))
    ) AS order_id,

    -- Normalized customer_id
    customer_id_str AS customer_id,

    -- Business order timestamp derived from placed_at
    try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS order_date,

    -- Created-at approximated from placed_at (no dedicated created_at column available)
    try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS created_at,

    -- No updated_at field in source; exposed as NULLable timestamp
    CAST(NULL AS timestamp) AS updated_at,

    -- Normalized order status
    LOWER(order_status_str) AS order_status,

    -- Canonical numeric amount
    try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS total_amount,

    -- No currency field in source; exposed as NULLable string
    CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS currency,

    -- Ingestion timestamp approximated from business order timestamp (no dedicated ingest column)
    try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS ingestion_ts,

    -- Source table identifier
    'AwsDataCatalog.test_raw.raw_orders' AS source_table,

    -- Deterministic row hash for change detection
    to_hex(
        md5(
            to_utf8(
                CONCAT_WS(
                    '|',
                    COALESCE(
                        COALESCE(
                            order_id_str,
                            to_hex(md5(to_utf8(COALESCE(customer_id_str, '') || '|' || COALESCE(placed_at_raw, ''))))
                        ),
                        ''
                    ),
                    COALESCE(customer_id_str, ''),
                    COALESCE(CAST(try_cast(placed_at_raw AS timestamp) AS varchar), ''),
                    COALESCE(CAST(try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS varchar), '')
                )
            )
        )
    ) AS row_hash,

    -- Quality flag for total_amount
    CASE
        WHEN try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) IS NOT NULL
             AND try_cast(total_amount_str AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) >= 0
        THEN TRUE
        ELSE FALSE
    END AS is_total_amount_non_negative
FROM base

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id       AS customer_id_raw,
        email,
        first_name        AS first_name_raw,
        last_name         AS last_name_raw,
        created_at        AS created_at_raw
    FROM {{ source("test_raw", "raw_customers") }}
),
clean AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id_raw,
        email,
        first_name_raw,
        last_name_raw,
        created_at_raw,
        -- cleaned customer_id (prefers raw customer_id; falls back to hash of email + names)
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(CAST(customer_id_raw AS varchar), ''),
            TO_HEX(
                MD5(
                    to_utf8(
                        CONCAT(
                            COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(email)), ''),
                            '|',
                            COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(first_name_raw)), ''),
                            '|',
                            COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(last_name_raw)), '')
                        )
                    )
                )
            )
        ) AS customer_id_clean,
        -- normalized email + validity flag
        CASE
            WHEN email IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(TRIM(email)), '^[^@\\s]+@[^@\\s]+\\.[^@\\s]+$')
                THEN LOWER(TRIM(email))
            ELSE NULL
        END AS normalized_email,
        CASE
            WHEN email IS NULL THEN FALSE
            WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(TRIM(email)), '^[^@\\s]+@[^@\\s]+\\.[^@\\s]+$')
                THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS is_email_valid,
        -- cleaned names
        NULLIF(TRIM(first_name_raw), '') AS first_name_clean,
        NULLIF(TRIM(last_name_raw), '')  AS last_name_clean,
        -- created_at as timestamp (source is string)
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(created_at_raw), '') AS timestamp) AS created_at_ts
    FROM base
)
SELECT
    -- raw passthrough columns (renamed with _raw where we also expose a cleaned version)
    customer_id_raw,
    email,
    first_name_raw,
    last_name_raw,
    created_at_raw,

    -- required raw helper
    email AS email_raw,

    -- cleaned / normalized columns per spec
    customer_id_clean AS customer_id,
    normalized_email,
    is_email_valid,
    first_name_clean  AS first_name,
    last_name_clean   AS last_name,
    created_at_ts     AS created_at,

    -- source table identifier
    'AwsDataCatalog.test_raw.raw_customers' AS source_table,

    -- row-level hash for change detection (limited to available fields)
    TO_HEX(
        MD5(
            to_utf8(
                CONCAT_WS(
                    '|',
                    COALESCE(customer_id_clean, ''),
                    COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(email)), ''),
                    COALESCE(CAST(created_at_ts AS varchar), '')
                )
            )
        )
    ) AS row_hash
FROM clean
